journey.title: The registration's journey
journey.heldKept: deadline passed, the place is kept while nobody asks for it
journey.legend:
The six steps of a registration:
– 1 · Form sent — the person filled in the registration form.
– 2 · Email confirmed — the address is confirmed: with the link from the email, or by staff at the desk.
– 3 · Place held — has a held place, or is on the waiting list.
– 4 · Declaration signed — signed the declaration, online or on paper.
– 5 · Place confirmed — the registration is complete, with a place and a declaration.
– 6 · Present at the race — came to the desk on race day and picked up the number.
The figure in the column shows how many steps the registration has reached.

placeDeadlines.releaseClosed: Past the deadline a place is not lost by itself: it is freed only when someone waiting has no other free place; registration has closed: «Send them the offer», or «Give a place» at the desk.
placeDeadlines.releaseNoList: Past the deadline a place is not lost by itself: it is released only when someone new asks for it and no other place is free.
placeDeadlines.releaseNever: Past the deadline a place is not lost: the event has no limit of places.
placeDeadlines.atStart: At the start, whoever has not signed loses the place; at the desk they can be confirmed on paper, if a place is still free.

emailLink.one: One person has not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registration expires; until then it holds no place.
emailLink.few: {count} people have not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registrations expire; until then they hold no place.
emailLink.other: {count} people have not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registrations expire; until then they hold no place.

emailLinkFamily.one: One person has not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registration expires; until then it holds a place only if a family reserved it.
emailLinkFamily.few: {count} people have not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registrations expire; until then only those a family reserved hold a place.
emailLinkFamily.other: {count} people have not confirmed their address yet: the link is valid for {hours} from when the email leaves, then the registrations expire; until then only those a family reserved hold a place.

offerAuto.one: One person has an offer from the waiting list, valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, it goes to the next in line while registration is open.
offerAuto.few: {count} people have an offer from the waiting list, each valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, it goes to the next in line while registration is open.
offerAuto.other: {count} people have an offer from the waiting list, each valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, it goes to the next in line while registration is open.

offerManual.one: One person has an offer from the waiting list, valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, the place stays free until you give it.
offerManual.few: {count} people have an offer from the waiting list, each valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, the place stays free until you give it.
offerManual.other: {count} people have an offer from the waiting list, each valid for at most {hours} from when the email leaves; unsigned in time, the place stays free until you give it.

registrations.givePlaceNowHelp: For someone who did not manage to confirm the address: you vouch for it, and they get the place and the declaration email.
registrations.placeGiven: Place given; the declaration email has left. Deadline: {deadline}.
registrations.placeGivenRaised: Place given, on a supplementary place: the capacity is now {n}. The declaration email has left. Deadline: {deadline}.

answers.title: The registration's answers
answers.openHelp: Everything the person typed on the form, the phone and the emergency contact included; opening it stays in the log.
answers.viewed: Opening these answers stayed in the log, with your name.
answers.displayNameHelp: Empty: the first and last name.
answers.phoneHelp: With the country code (+40 712 345 678); a Romanian number also works with a leading 0.
answers.guardianHelp: Only for someone who was a minor when they registered, and then required. A birth date corrected to an adult's clears it.
answers.guardianSignedHelp: The declaration is signed and names them: it does not change here.
answers.clubNameHelp: While the member tick is on, the club is {club}.
answers.memberHelp: Unticked, the club {club} also goes from the list.
answers.lockedAddress: The email address is the registration's identity: for a wrong address, cancel and add it again.
answers.lockedConsents: Only the person gives the consents — you can only withdraw them, with their own button.
answers.lockedDeclaration: Only the person signs the declaration; once it is signed, the parent or guardian it names stays the one who signed.

fields.listSocials: Strava and Instagram on the list

memberSweep.open: Member ticks with no member account
memberSweep.title: Member ticks with no member account

count.one: {count} registration with the member tick and no member account
count.few: {count} registrations with the member tick and no member account
count.other: {count} registrations with the member tick and no member account

memberSweep.scopeAll: At every event that has not started.
memberSweep.who: A member is an account on Staff, with any role, matched by email address. A revoked account is no longer a member.
memberSweep.otherAddress: A member registered with another address than their account's appears here too: untick their row to keep their tick («Leave the tick»).
memberSweep.emptyHelp: Every ticked registration has a member account with the same address.
memberSweep.rowHelp: Ticked = cleared · unticked = Leave the tick

cleared.one: Cleared the member tick on {count} registration. Nothing else changed.
cleared.few: Cleared the member tick on {count} registrations. Nothing else changed.
cleared.other: Cleared the member tick on {count} registrations. Nothing else changed.

tell.title: What to tell them
tell.help: The sentence to tell someone who asks where their registration stands; the same words they read themselves.

inLanguage.ro: In Romanian, the language they registered in.
inLanguage.en: In English, the language they registered in.

tell.PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION: Press the button to confirm your address. If there is still a place, you then sign the declaration and get your QR code.
tell.linkLapsed: The link in the confirmation email has expired, so your address is not confirmed and we hold no place for you.
tell.kept: The deadline to sign has passed, but we are still keeping your place: sign the declaration from the email as soon as you can.
tell.WAITLISTED: We'll let you know if a place opens up.
tell.offer: A place has opened up for you. It is yours if you sign the self-declaration by {due}.
tell.offerQueued: We have offered you a place; the offer email is on its way, and the time to sign counts from when it is sent.
tell.offerLapsed: The offer's deadline has passed, so the place is no longer held for you.
tell.CONFIRMED: The QR code for picking up your number is in the confirmation email and on your registration's page.
tell.CANCELLED: Registration cancelled. Your place has been released.
tell.EXPIRED: The registration has expired, so we no longer hold a place for you.
tell.holdLapsed: Your place has expired: the declaration was not signed in time.
tell.linkUntil: The link in the email is valid until {instant}.

events.empty: There is no event in the database.
events.registrationModeTitle: The registration mode, from the event's settings
events.seriesRenewsUntil: Renews itself: the site creates the dates {horizon} ahead, until {until}.
events.seriesRenewsForever: Renews itself: the site creates the dates {horizon} ahead, for ever.
events.seriesDeleteNote: A series is deleted from the bar above the list: tick it, then “Delete the ticked ones”.
events.tableCaption: The club's events, with their status, date and number of registrations
events.deleteBlocked: Cannot be deleted: {count} people have registered. Archive the event, or use “Permanent deletion…” below, which deletes the registrations too.
events.eventsRepeatedOne: The series is running: {dates} created now, up to {until} — the next {horizon}. The site creates the rest by itself, always {horizon} ahead, until the chosen date or for ever.
events.eventsRepeatedMany: The series is running: {dates} created now, up to {until} — the next {horizon}. The site creates the rest by itself, always {horizon} ahead, until the chosen date or for ever.
events.seriesDraftsOne: {dates} in draft, not on the site:
events.seriesDraftsMany: {dates} in draft, not on the site:
events.seriesDraftsNewOne: {dates}, created automatically, is not on the site:
events.seriesDraftsNewMany: {dates}, created automatically, are not on the site:
events.seriesDraftsSourceOne: {dates} of the series is not on the site — the series is not published:
events.seriesDraftsSourceMany: {dates} of the series are not on the site — the series is not published:
events.seriesDraftsHintNew: The series creates its own dates for the next {horizon}; with automatic publication off, each new date stays a draft until you publish it.
events.seriesDraftsHintSource: The series starts from an event that is not published; until you publish it, the dates it creates stay drafts too.
events.seriesDraftsPublishBody: They go on the site and, if the event takes registrations, registration opens. A date with a language left incomplete stays a draft.
events.seriesDraftsAutoPublishBody: From now on, every new date the series creates goes on the site by itself. The dates already created, on this row, stay drafts — publish those with “{button}”.
events.seriesAutoPublishStarted: Automatic publication is on: the series' new dates go on the site by themselves. The ones already created stay drafts until you press “{button}”.
events.bulkHelp: Tick events: “Publish” publishes those complete in both languages, “Archive” takes them off the site, “Delete” removes the ones nobody registered for.

eventsDeleteFailed.one: {count} could not be deleted — it has registrations. Archive it, or use “Permanent deletion…” in the row's ⋮ menu, which deletes the registrations too.
eventsDeleteFailed.few: {count} could not be deleted — they have registrations. Archive those, or use “Permanent deletion…” in the row's ⋮ menu, which deletes the registrations too.
eventsDeleteFailed.other: {count} could not be deleted — they have registrations. Archive those, or use “Permanent deletion…” in the row's ⋮ menu, which deletes the registrations too.

eventsPublishFailed.one: {count} could not be published: a language is incomplete, or it changed meanwhile.
eventsPublishFailed.few: {count} could not be published: a language is incomplete, or they changed meanwhile.
eventsPublishFailed.other: {count} could not be published: a language is incomplete, or they changed meanwhile.

events.eventErased: Event permanently deleted, together with {erased} registrations.
events.listSearchHelp: The title, the page address or the place
events.listEmpty: No event matches. Choose another state, «All» for instance, or change the search.

confirm.duplicateBody: A copy is created as a draft, with its own page addresses. It is not featured and it is not published.
confirm.deleteBody: Deleting is permanent. Only an event nobody has registered for can be deleted; for one that has happened, archive it instead.
confirm.bulkDeleteBody: Deleting is permanent. Every ticked event nobody has registered for is removed, in both languages; the ones with registrations are left as they are and counted.
confirm.archiveBody: The event comes off the site, in both languages. You can bring it back later by sending it through review and publishing it again.
confirm.removeTestBody: Every test registration for this event is deleted, along with the synthetic participants behind them. Real registrations are left untouched.
confirm.cancelRegistrationBody: The person is emailed. The reason stays in the log; they get it only if the refusal is ticked. It cannot be undone. The place is offered to the first on the waiting list or stays free, by the setting.
confirm.cancelRegistrationPrintedBody: Number {number} is already printed; after cancelling it stays retired — never given to anybody else — and must be pulled out of the pile.
confirm.repeatBody: The next events are created at the chosen interval, each with its own address. You can edit or delete them one by one afterwards.
confirm.repeatPublishOnBody: From now on, every new date the series creates goes on the site by itself, in both languages. The dates already created stay as they are.
confirm.bibsBody: Every confirmed registration without a number gets the next free one, in order of confirmation. Numbers already given stay.
confirm.sparesBody: The numbers start at {from}, after the highest number given or reserved, and stay the desk's: nobody who registers online gets them. A reservation is not undone; unused numbers stay unused.
confirm.bulkEraseTitle: Erase the ticked registrations for good?
confirm.bulkEraseBody: This cannot be undone. The places are released through the waiting list and the participants' data leave the record.

email.one: An email will be sent to {count} participant.
email.few: An email will be sent to {count} participants.
email.other: An email will be sent to {count} participants.

emailMessages.one: {count} email from the queue is sent now.
emailMessages.few: {count} emails from the queue are sent now.
emailMessages.other: {count} emails from the queue are sent now.

confirm.publishBody: It appears on the site in both languages. An event with registration on the site opens it within its window.
confirm.unpublishBody: It disappears from the site in both languages until you publish it again. What already exists — registrations, photos — stays.
confirm.archiveContentBody: It disappears from the site in both languages. You can bring it back later, through review and publication again.
confirm.bulkPublishBody: Every ticked event with both languages complete appears on the site; the others stay as they are and are counted.
confirm.bulkArchiveBody: They disappear from the site in both languages. You can bring them back later, one at a time.
confirm.saveNoticeBody: The changes are saved, and the participants receive “Details updated”, each in their language — if the place, the start or the programme changed, the event was reinstated, or you wrote a note.
confirm.cancelEventBody: It shows as cancelled on the site, registration no longer opens and existing registrations stay on record. The participants receive “Event cancelled” with your reason.
confirm.cancelEventQuietBody: It shows as cancelled on the site, registration no longer opens and existing registrations stay on record. The participants are not told.
confirm.givePlaceBody: {name} gets a free place ahead of the waiting list, and the confirmation with the race number.
confirm.setBibBody: The person is emailed the number. A number once given is never given to anybody else.

resendWhat.PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION: {name} gets the link to confirm the address again; the link in the old email stops working.
resendWhat.PENDING_DECLARATION: {name} gets the link to sign the declaration again; the link in the old email stops working.
resendWhat.WAITLISTED: {name} gets the waiting-list email again, with where the line stands now; the link in the old email stops working.
resendWhat.WAITLIST_OFFERED: {name} gets the offer of a place again; the link in the old email stops working.
resendWhat.CONFIRMED: {name} gets the confirmation with the QR code again; the link in the old email stops working.
resendWhat.CANCELLED: {name} gets the notice about the state of the registration again.
resendWhat.EXPIRED: {name} gets the notice about the state of the registration again.

confirm.createRegistrationBody: The person is registered for the event on their behalf, at their request, and receives the email for the next step.
confirm.withdrawConsentBody: The ticked data disappears from the registration for good; the reason stays in the log, without the person's name.
confirm.eraseRegistrationBody: It cannot be undone. The place is released through the waiting list, and the person's data disappears from the records.
confirm.bulkCancelBody: Each person is emailed, without the reason. Each place is offered to the first on the waiting list or stays free, by the event's setting. The registrations stay, marked cancelled.
confirm.sendNowBody: The queue goes out now, without waiting for the monitor, and stops at the day's limit.
confirm.interestWithdrawBody: The address typed is removed from “Notify me” and no longer receives the announcement that registration opened.
confirm.inviteStaffTitle: Add the person to the team?
confirm.inviteStaffBody: They receive the sign-in invitation by email, with the chosen role, and can enter as soon as they set a password: the backoffice, or — as a Member — only the members' area on the site.
confirm.changeRoleBody: {name} gets the chosen role from the next page they open.
confirm.approvePlatformBody: To be approved: {texts}. From this moment they are in effect on the site, as the club's texts; a correction is a new version.
confirm.approveVersionBody: The text becomes public and can no longer be changed. A later correction means a new version.
confirm.emailPlanBody: The quotas, “how much we can still send” and the cost table follow the new plan from now on.
confirm.emailTransportBody: From now on the chosen groups leave through Gmail, within the limit and with the pause set here; the rest through Mailgun. Emails already sent stay as they were.
confirm.contactRecipientsTitle: Change who receives the contact messages?
confirm.contactRecipientsBody: Messages from the contact form reach the saved addresses from now on, and only them.
confirm.clubNoticesTitle: Change who receives the club's copies?
confirm.clubNoticesBody: Signed declarations, confirmations and the copies of messages to participants — with their personal data — go from now on to the addresses saved, and only to them.
confirm.emailCopyResetTitle: Go back to the default text?
confirm.emailCopyResetBody: The club's own text for this email, in this language, is lost; emails sent from now on use the default text.
confirm.botCheckOnBody: The public forms show Cloudflare's “I am not a robot” box; a failed check stops the send.
confirm.botCheckOffBody: The public forms no longer ask “I am not a robot”. The hidden trap and the per-address limit stay.
confirm.honeypotOnBody: A hidden field people never see; a form that fills it in is refused.
confirm.honeypotOffBody: The field stays and is logged, but refuses nobody any more.
confirm.deadlinesBody: The new deadlines apply to holds, offers and links given from now on. Nothing already given changes.
confirm.addressCapBody: From now on, at every event, one email address may register at most this many people, and the email offering to register someone else says the new number. Registrations already made all stay.
confirm.jobCadenceBody: The email queue and the maintenance run at most once per chosen interval; an email may wait that long.
confirm.neonPlanBody: The costs and limits on this page are worked out from the plan chosen whenever Neon does not state its own plan.
confirm.vercelPlanBody: The costs on this page are worked out from the plan and the seats chosen.
confirm.olderPicturesBody: The pictures in this batch get their smaller sizes; the old address keeps working. It takes about twenty seconds. An editor open on a page using them will ask for a reload.
confirm.shownAddressBody: The site shows the chosen address from now on, and replies to the club's emails go to it. Approved legal texts keep their own address.
confirm.publicPhoneBody: The site shows this number at the foot of every page from now on. An empty box takes it off.
confirm.siteTintBody: Every public page of the site opens with the chosen background from now on, for every visitor. The dark theme and the backoffice stay as they are. You can go back to “White” at any time.
confirm.siteFontSizeBody: Every public page of the site now opens with its text at the chosen size, for every visitor, in both themes. The backoffice stays as it is. You can go back to «Normal» at any time.
confirm.translationBudgetBody: The new number applies from the next press of "Translate from Romanian". What was translated today stays counted.
confirm.deliveryTimingBody: It applies from now on to every email the site sends, including those already in the queue. No message is lost.
confirm.inviteMembersBody: Every address on the list gets the Member role and the sign-in invitation by email. Once they set a password, a member enters only the members' area on the site — never the backoffice.

sendNowChoice.now: Send now, without waiting for the scheduled round
sendNowChoice.queue: Queue it for the scheduled round
sendNowChoice.note: For now, automatic emails leave on the scheduled round, within {wait}. Choose whether this one leaves now or waits for it.

confirm.menuOrderBody: The site's menu and footer show the pages in the new order, for every visitor, from the next page they open.
confirm.resendFamilyBody: One email goes to their address, for everybody: {names}. Each gets the step they are at, with a new link; the links in the old emails stop working.
confirm.offerPlaceBody: {name} gets the email “{message}” and has until {deadline} to sign; they go ahead of the people before them.
confirm.givePlaceNowBody: You vouch for the address {email} and give them a place ahead of the waiting list.
confirm.givePlaceNowBodyMore: They get the declaration email at once and sign it online any time before the deadline, or on paper at the desk. They have nothing else to confirm.
confirm.givePlaceNowFull: No place is free: pressing adds one supplementary place over the limit; the capacity becomes {n}.
confirm.outsideMarkTitle: Put this registration on the special guests list?
confirm.outsideMarkBody: {name} goes on the special guests list and no longer takes a place; the freed place goes to the first in line if offers go out automatically. State, number and emails stay.
confirm.outsideMarkBodyWaitlisted: {name} leaves the waiting list and gets a place as a special guest now: the email “{message}”, with the usual deadline.
confirm.outsideMarkBodyWaitlistedTest: {name} leaves the waiting list and gets a place as a special guest now: the declaration to sign, with the usual deadline.
confirm.outsideMarkBodyOffered: Instead of the offer, {name} gets a place as a special guest now: the email “{message}”, with the usual deadline. The offer's place is freed.
confirm.outsideMarkBodyOfferedTest: Instead of the offer, {name} gets a place as a special guest now: the declaration to sign, with the usual deadline. The offer's place is freed.
confirm.outsideMarkBodyPendingEmail: {name} goes on the special guests list once they confirm their address; nothing changes until then.
confirm.outsideUnmarkTitle: Take this registration off the special guests list?
confirm.outsideUnmarkBody: {name} will take one of the event's places. If none is free, nothing changes.
confirm.givePlaceNowRaiseConfirm: Add a place and give it to them
confirm.offerPlaceRaise: No place is free: pressing adds one supplementary place over the limit; the capacity becomes {n}.
confirm.offerPlaceRaiseConfirm: Add a place and send the offer
confirm.offerPlaceAfterClose: Registration has closed: the offer holds until the start at the latest.

memberSweepBody.one: You clear the member tick on {count} registration; nothing else changes, no email.
memberSweepBody.few: You clear the member tick on {count} registrations; nothing else changes, no email.
memberSweepBody.other: You clear the member tick on {count} registrations; nothing else changes, no email.

confirm.answersBody: You correct, for {name}: {fields}. Nothing else changes, no email; the old values stay in the log.
confirm.memberClearBody: You clear the member tick from {name}; nothing else changes, no email.
confirm.memberSetBody: You set the member tick on {name}; their club on the list becomes {club}. Nothing else changes, no email.

errors.PICTURE_IN_USE: The picture is used on a page, an event or in an album. Take it out of there first.
errors.NOTHING_SELECTED: You did not tick any registration.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not allow this.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Check what you entered; something is not valid.
errors.HIDDEN_LIST_OFF: The special guests list is off for this event. Tick «Use the special guests list» in the event's settings first.
errors.SPARES_BEFORE_HIDDEN_LIST: The spare numbers no longer fit before the special guests' series. Move «The special guests' numbers start at» higher in the event's settings, or print fewer.
errors.HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES: «The special guests' numbers start at» falls inside the race's series, or the places have reached it. Move it outside the race's series in the event's settings. Nothing was done.
errors.HIDDEN_LIST_IN_RACE_SERIES_DATED: On one of the dates ({date}), «The special guests' numbers start at» would fall inside the race's series. Move it outside the series, or save without that date. Nothing was saved, on any date.
errors.HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES: The special guests' series would run through the desk's spare numbers. Move «The special guests' numbers start at» above them in the event's settings. Nothing was done.
errors.HIDDEN_LIST_ON_SPARES_DATED: On one of the dates ({date}), the special guests' series would run through the desk's spares. Move «The special guests' numbers start at» above them, or save without that date. Nothing was saved.
errors.INVALID_ADDRESSES: Not email addresses: {addresses}. Separate the addresses with commas, spaces or line breaks. Nothing was saved.
errors.TOO_MANY_ADDRESSES: At most {max} addresses in one box. Nothing was saved.
errors.ONE_ADDRESS_ONLY: “Signed declarations go to” takes one address — the archive mailbox. Put the others under “Visible copy (Cc)” or “Hidden copy (Bcc)”. Nothing was saved.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone else saved while you were editing. Reload the page and reapply your changes — nothing of yours was overwritten.
errors.DECLARATION_HELD: Nothing was erased: a declaration is kept for a complaint or a dispute. An Administrator removes the keep first, on the registration's page or the run's signatures.
errors.ERASE_NAME_MISMATCH: The name you typed is not this participant's name. Nothing was erased — type the name exactly as the row shows it.
errors.LEGAL_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: What you typed does not name this version. Nothing was deleted — type the phrase exactly as asked, for example “GDPR 2”.
errors.LEGAL_DELETE_NEEDS_REASON: Type a reason. It is the only thing left after the deletion.
errors.LEGAL_TERMS_ACCEPTED: Nothing was deleted: someone registered or signed while this version was in force. You can withdraw it instead — it stays on the record and is no longer offered.
errors.SITE_TINT_UNREADABLE: The colour was not saved: on it, the page's text or the secondary text would have a contrast under 4.5 : 1 (level AA). Choose a lighter colour.
errors.SITE_TINT_TOO_DARK: The colour was not saved: it is too dark for a light page, and the white cards would no longer stand out. Choose a lighter colour.
errors.UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: Nothing was registered: by the birth date typed, this person is not yet {age} old on the day of the race, the minimum age for this event. Check the date with them.
errors.NEON_QUOTA_BELOW_USAGE: The limit was not sent: it must be above what has been spent so far, or it would stop the database the moment it is saved.
errors.NEON_QUOTA_UNCONFIRMED: Nothing changed: a new or changed limit on production needs the confirmation box ticked — when it is reached, the site stops until the next period.
errors.NEON_UNCONFIGURED: Nothing changed: NEON_API_KEY or NEON_PROJECT_ID is missing on this environment.
errors.NEON_KEY_FORBIDDEN: Neon refused the change: the key in NEON_API_KEY may read the project but not modify it. Set a project-scoped key and redeploy.
errors.NEON_BUSY: Neon was working on another change to the project and did not take this one. Try again in a minute; the figures above the form are what Neon holds now.
errors.NEON_REFUSED: Neon refused the values sent. The figures above the form are what Neon holds now; if the size chosen is above what the plan allows, choose a smaller one.
errors.NEON_UNREACHABLE: Neon did not answer, or answered with something the page cannot read. The figures above the form are what Neon holds now; try again in a minute.
errors.NEON_QUOTA_REMOVAL_UNCONFIRMED: Nothing changed: removing production's limit needs the same confirmation box ticked — with no limit, production has no spending cap at all.
errors.WAITLIST_FULL: The places and the waiting list are full, so nothing changed. Try again once a slot on the list frees up.
errors.NO_WAITLIST: Every place is taken and the event has no waiting list, so nothing changed.
errors.WALK_IN_LEFT_UNCONFIRMED: The person is entered, but the last place just went, so they are unconfirmed and got no email. Confirm them on paper once a place frees up.
errors.NO_FREE_PLACE: The race is full: places {capacity}, confirmed {confirmed}, declarations to sign {declaration}, offered {offered}, reserved for families {family}, invited {invited}. Raise the capacity first.
errors.SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED: Nothing was changed: the places changed since you opened the page, and the question did not say this supplementary place would be added. Press again: the question now says what the capacity becomes.
errors.NO_RECIPIENTS: Nothing was sent: nobody is in the chosen group right now. Choose another group.
errors.MESSAGE_UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER: Nothing was sent: {names} is not a field we can fill in this message. The fields you can use are listed under the boxes.
errors.SAMPLE_VALUE_IN_EMAIL: The text contains the sample value “{value}” — use {placeholder}.
errors.SAMPLE_VALUES_IN_EMAIL: The text contains sample values, not fields: {found}. Use the fields in their place.
errors.BIB_NUMBER_TAKEN: That number is already somebody's at this event: given, held, or worn by an erased registration. Pick another number from the box and try again.
errors.WALK_IN_BIB_TAKEN: The person is entered, but somebody just gave that number away, so they are unconfirmed. Find them in the list and press “Confirm here” with another number.
errors.STAFF_ALREADY_ON_ADDRESS: This person is already registered for the event with this email address. Look them up in the registrations list; for another person, type their name.
errors.STAFF_ADDRESS_AT_CAP: This address already has as many registrations for the event as the club allows per address (“Deadlines”). Use another email address for this person.
errors.MEMBERS_ON_TEAM: Already on the team: {addresses}. Take them off the list. Nobody was added.
errors.LEGAL_BATCH_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The typed confirmation is not the one asked for. Nothing was deleted — type exactly the text under the box, for example "DELETE 2".
errors.LEGAL_BATCH_VERSION_BLOCKED: Nothing was deleted: meanwhile, {version} can no longer be deleted. Reload the page: it is listed under what stays, with the reason; the others go on the next press.
errors.SEND_NOW_ALLOWANCE_SPENT: Nothing was sent: the Mailgun plan's limit for today is reached. Choose «Queue it»; the email leaves after the reset.
errors.BULK_RESEND_CLOSED: The declaration can no longer be signed: the event is cancelled, finished or has already started. Nothing is resent.
errors.BULK_RESEND_LIMITED: Resending to everyone has reached its hourly limit for this event. The emails from earlier presses are queued; try again in an hour.
errors.LEGAL_NUMBER_MISMATCH: The number you typed is not this version's. Nothing was deleted — type only the number, for example “6”.
errors.LEGAL_RETIRE_NEEDS_REASON: Type the reason, 3 to 200 characters. It stays beside the version, under “Deleted versions”.
errors.LEGAL_NOTHING_DEPENDS: Nothing was deleted: meanwhile nothing depends on this version any more. Reload the page and delete it permanently.
errors.LEGAL_RETIRE_IN_FORCE: Nothing was deleted: this is the version in force. Approve the next version first, then you can delete this one.
errors.LEGAL_ALREADY_DELETED: This version has already been deleted from the list. Its text stays in the archive.
errors.SEND_NOW_HOUR_SPENT: Nothing was sent: Mailgun's hourly limit («Hourly limit» under «Emails») has no room right now. Choose «Queue it»; the email leaves on its own once the hour has room again.
errors.RETRY_FAILED_THROTTLED: Nothing was put back: the failed emails were already retried 3 times in the last hour. Wait a while, and look at why they failed before pressing again.
errors.SEND_NOW_MAILGUN_STOPPED_FALLBACK_OFF: Nothing was sent: Mailgun is stopped and «Gmail takes over when Mailgun stops» is set to No. Set it to Yes under «Emails», or choose «Queue it»: it leaves when Mailgun resumes.
errors.SEND_NOW_MAILGUN_STOPPED_NO_GMAIL: Nothing was sent: Mailgun is stopped and the club's Gmail is not configured here. Choose «Queue it»: the email leaves on its own when Mailgun resumes.
errors.SEND_NOW_MAILGUN_STOPPED_GMAIL_FULL: Nothing was sent: Mailgun is stopped and Gmail has reached its daily limit. Raise it under «Emails» (500 at most), or choose «Queue it»: it leaves when Mailgun resumes.
errors.SEND_NOW_MAILGUN_STOPPED_NOTICE: Nothing was sent: Mailgun is stopped, and Gmail takes over only once you approve the privacy notice from the new template. Until then choose «Queue it».
errors.INVITATION_NOT_OPEN: The invitation is no longer waiting: it was accepted, withdrawn or has expired.
errors.INVITATION_EVENT_CLOSED: The event takes no more invitations: it is cancelled, has started, or is not published.
errors.INVITATION_BAD_DAYS: Days until it expires: a whole number from 1 to 60.
errors.ANSWERS_UNCHANGED: Nothing changed: the answers already say this. Reload the page if a colleague corrected them meanwhile.
errors.ANSWER_UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: The date of birth was not saved: the person would not be {age} on race day, the event's minimum age.
errors.ANSWER_EMERGENCY_SAME: The emergency contact's phone was not saved: it is the participant's own number. Type someone else's.
errors.ANSWER_GUARDIAN_SIGNED: The parent or guardian was not changed: the signed declaration names the one who signed it.
errors.ANSWER_SOCIALS_MINOR_AT_REGISTRATION: Strava and Instagram were not saved: the person was a minor when they registered, and the maintenance sweep would delete them. Leave them empty.
errors.ANSWER_BIRTH_DATE_MINOR_AT_REGISTRATION: The birth date was not saved: the person would have been a minor when they registered; empty Strava and Instagram first.
errors.ANSWER_BIRTH_DATE_GUARDIAN_SIGNED: The birth date was not saved: it would make the person a minor, and the declaration was signed with no parent or guardian, who cannot be added now.
errors.ANSWER_BIRTH_DATE_GUARDIAN_SIGNED_ADULT: The birth date was not saved: it would make the person an adult when they registered, and the declaration was signed by the parent or guardian it names, who cannot be removed now.
errors.ANSWER_GUARDIAN_ADULT: The parent or guardian was not saved: the person was not a minor when they registered. Only a minor's registration names a parent or guardian.

draftPreview.intro: The listing card, the event page and the registration form, from what you have typed now. Nothing is saved or published.
draftPreview.idle: Press «Preview» to see the card, the page and the form.
draftPreview.asOfPress: Shows what was typed at the last press of «Preview».
draftPreview.complete: Both languages have everything publication needs.
draftPreview.refused: This cannot be previewed as it is: the save would refuse these boxes.
draftPreview.failed: The preview did not work. Try again.
draftPreview.forbidden: Your role cannot preview the event.

editor.startsAtHelp: Local time of the event ({timezone}). For a race this is the gathering time.
editor.raceStartsAtHelp: When the gun goes. If it is the event's start, type the same time.
editor.raceStartNotSetHelp: Ticked, the site shows only "(event start)" with the event's start time, and under it "The race start time is announced later."
editor.mapUrlHelp: Optional. The meeting point on Google Maps or any other map. It must start with https://.
editor.coordinatesHelp: Optional: latitude, longitude, e.g. 45.6427, 25.5887 — right-click the point in Google Maps. Only for the weather, when the map link does not carry them.

weatherPlace.map: The weather is read for the point in the map link ({coordinates}).
weatherPlace.typed: The weather is read for these coordinates ({coordinates}).
weatherPlace.club: The weather is read for {place} ({coordinates}): the map link carries no coordinates and none are typed.

editor.locationHelp: The place, as you would tell a friend, in Romanian and in English. If the name is the same, press “Same name in English”.
editor.locationEnglishLeftBehind: The English box still says “{place}”. If the place has moved, change it here too.
editor.placeToBeAnnouncedHelp: On, everywhere says “Location to be announced soon” and the place and the map stay hidden. What you fill in stays unpublished until you turn it off.
editor.placeUnpublished: Not published while the location is to be announced.
editor.dateToBeAnnouncedHelp: Ticked, every page says “Date to be announced soon”. The date and time above may stay empty; nothing typed there is published. Registration stays “opening soon”.
editor.timeToBeAnnouncedHelp: Ticked, the day shows on the site and “Time to be announced soon” stands in for the time. The time above may stay empty. Registration stays “opening soon”, off the calendar.
editor.featured: Lead the site with this event
editor.featuredHelp: Only one event can be featured. The previously featured one loses the flag automatically.
editor.specialHelp: An edition apart, such as an anniversary or a charity run, with a badge on the card and the page. In a series, the badge stays on this date only.
editor.readOnly: The Administrator changes the event; here you can read it. Tell them what you want changed.
editor.liveWarning: Published: every save appears on the site at once, in both languages.
editor.acknowledgeLive: I understand that I am editing published content.
editor.acknowledgeLiveHint: Tick that you understand you are changing published content to be able to save.
editor.slugHelp: The page address, in lowercase words joined by hyphens. It can only change before the first publication.
editor.slugLocked: The page has been published, so its address stays as it is.
editor.costHelp: What a participant pays; the site collects no money. If the place is given only once paid, choose “Paid” and add the payment link.
editor.costAmountHelp: For example "50 lei". Required for a paid event.
editor.costPaidUrlHelp: The link where payment is made. Must start with https://.
editor.costDonationUrlHelp: Required. The link where the donation is made, on another site. Must start with https://.
editor.discountNoteHelp: What discount members get and how they use it — the code, until when

fields.title: Title
fields.excerpt: Summary — shown on the page, on the listing card and in shares
fields.checklist: What to bring — one line, in the emails and the calendar
fields.body: Content — shown on the event page, under the title

editor.excerptHelp: One or two sentences: what the event page, the listing card (with a picture, if any) and the shares carry. Required before publication.
editor.routeDescriptionEmpty: Nothing yet. Press to write it.
editor.excerptEmpty: Required before publication. Press to write it.
editor.bodyEmpty: Nothing yet. Press to write it.
editor.programmeHelp: The day by the hour, one row each: kits, briefing, start, awards. Shown on the page, in the reminder email and in the calendar; leave “Where” empty for the event's own place.
editor.rulesHelp: Optional, in both languages or neither: the race rules. Shown on the page under “Rules”; the declaration and the emails point there.
editor.checklistHelp: Optional, in both languages or neither, at most 300 characters: “race number, water, a jacket”. It goes in the confirmation email, the reminder and the calendar entry.
editor.typeHelp: A group run takes no registration; a race has registration and a programme; an external event registers on the organiser's page.
editor.distanceEstimatedHelp: Tick when the distance is approximate — the site shows it with “≈” and “approximate”.
editor.elevationGainEstimatedHelp: Tick when the number is a guess — the site shows it with “≈” and “estimated”.

night.label: Night event
night.autoLine: Automatic: on {day}, starts at {start}, sunset at {sunset} — {verdict}
night.autoLineDawn: Automatic: on {day}, starts at {start}, before sunrise at {sunrise} — {verdict}
night.autoLineNoTime: Automatic: on {day}, sunset at {sunset} — pick the start time
night.autoLineNoDate: Automatic: pick the start's date and time under “When and where”, and the answer shows here.
night.endLine: The start is before dusk, but the run lasts until {end} and reaches the dark — still a night event.
night.endLineProgramme: The start is before dusk, but the day's programme runs until {end} (its last row) and reaches the dark — still a night event.
night.series: In a series, each date follows its own day's sunset: the winter dates are night events, the summer ones are not.
night.help: Automatic: a night event when any part of it falls after dusk or before dawn. Shown on the card, the page, the calendar and the reminder email.

editor.registrationModeHelp: Registration here needs a declaration; registration elsewhere needs the organiser's link.
editor.capacityHelp: Leave empty for unlimited. It cannot be lowered below the places already taken.
editor.capacityWaiting: On the waiting list: {waiting}. If you raise the number, the new places are offered at once, in order, {offer} each.
editor.waitlistModeHelp: What happens once the places are taken.
editor.waitlistModeTip: Unlimited: anyone may join the list once the places are taken. Limited: at most this many people. No waiting list: a full event turns everyone away.

waitlistModeChoices.LIMITED: Limited to a number of places

editor.waitlistCapacity: At most this many people on the list
editor.waitlistCapacityHelp: Lowered below how many already wait, it removes nobody; it just takes no one new. Empty or 0: the list becomes unlimited.
editor.registrationOpensSoonHelp: Ticked, the page says “Registration opens soon” and the form stays closed. Untick it to open: the people who asked to be told get the email.
editor.kitShirtHelp: When ticked, the form asks for the T-shirt size.
editor.askHealthNoteHelp: When ticked, the form asks for medical information (conditions, allergies, medication); it is deleted {days} after the event.
editor.registrationWindowHelp: Leave the opening empty and registration opens when the event is published; leave the closing empty and it closes when the event starts.
editor.declarationDocumentHelp: Mountain event for mountain or forest; road or park event for asphalt, concrete, tartan, paving. It starts from the surface in “The course”; you can change it. Approved under Legal documents.
editor.declarationNone: No approved declaration exists in this environment, so no event can take registrations here yet.
editor.participantList: Publish the participant list on the event page
editor.participantListHelp: Publishes the names of the confirmed who ticked “I want to appear on the participants & results list”, with no email addresses.
editor.waitlistPublicHelp: The public list also shows those on the waiting list who ticked “I want to appear”, in the list's order, with no position — only while the privacy notice in force describes the stages.
editor.waitlistPublicHelpMore: It applies only with the participant list published, above. Unticked, nobody on the waiting list appears, not even as a count.
editor.externalHelp: Both only for an event registered elsewhere. The link must start with https://.
editor.deleteHelp: A duplicate is created as a draft, with its own addresses. Delete only an event nobody registered for; archive the ones that happened.

difficultySteps.step1: The band's first level, the easiest
difficultySteps.step3: The band's last level, the hardest

editor.difficultyStepHelp: The level runs from {lowest} ({lowestBand}) to {highest} ({highestBand}): every band has three levels — {ranges}.

difficultyScale.FAIRLY_HARD: fairly hard {from}–{to}: from a half marathon up
difficultyScale.steps: in every band, the first level is the easiest, the third the hardest

editor.routeUrlHelp: Where the route can be seen — a Strava route or activity, or any other https:// link. Leave empty if there is not one.
editor.routeDescriptionHelp: Optional, in both languages or neither: stops, climbs, what to expect, a map (the picture button). Shown on the page under “The route”.
editor.repeatHelp: Make this event a series at a fixed interval. The next {horizon} are created now and the site creates the rest; each date can be moved or cancelled on its own.
editor.repeatUntilHelp: Leave empty for a series without an end.
editor.repeatStopHelp: No new dates are made; the ones already made stay — you delete them from the events list.
editor.repeatStopped: The series is stopped: no further dates will be made.
editor.repeatPublishOn: New dates of the series publish automatically: the source is published, so every new date starts published already.
editor.repeatPublishWaiting: Automatic publication is on, but waiting: the source is not published right now, so new dates start as drafts until it is published again.
editor.repeatPublishOff: New dates of the series start as drafts — automatic publication is off. You publish them yourself, from the list or from each one's own editor.
editor.repeatPublishStarted: Automatic publication has been turned on: from now on, new dates of the series publish by themselves.
editor.repeatPublishStopped: Automatic publication has been turned off: new dates of the series stay drafts until you publish them.
editor.savedSeriesOne: Saved — also on {dates} of the series.
editor.savedSeriesMany: Saved — also on {dates} of the series.
editor.savedSeriesOfferedOne: Saved — also on {dates} of the series; places offered to the waiting list: {offered}.
editor.savedSeriesOfferedMany: Saved — also on {dates} of the series; places offered to the waiting list: {offered}.
editor.savedOffered: Saved — places offered to the waiting list: {offered}.
editor.placeAnnouncedLive: The location is announced: it shows on the page, the cards, the calendar and in emails from now on. Those registered get no separate email about it.
editor.placeAnnouncedDraft: The location is announced: it will show on every page once the event is published. Nobody is emailed about it.

scope.title: Save for:
scope.help: As in Google Calendar: only what you changed here reaches the other dates; a date moved or cancelled on its own stays so.
scope.countThis: The save changes this date only.
scope.countFollowing: The save changes {dates}: {first} and the following {rest}, until {last}.
scope.countTail: A date moved or cancelled on its own stays as it is.

editor.repeatWeekdaysHelp: This event's day is always in the series; tick other days too, say Wednesday for a Sunday run.
editor.createdWithSeries: The event and {dates} were created, as drafts. Tick them in the events list and publish them together.
editor.durationHelp: How long it lasts — 1 hour 45 minutes, say. The end is worked out from it. Leave both empty if none was announced.

coHostRows.name: Partner's name
coHostRows.descriptionHelp: Optional, in both languages · a sentence or two: what we do together. Shown on the event's page, under the partner's name.
coHostRows.nameError: Partner {p}: a partner needs a name
coHostRows.kindError: Partner {p}, link {l}: choose the kind from the list
coHostRows.urlError: Partner {p}, link {l}: the address must start with https://
coHostRows.labelRoError: Partner {p}, link {l}: the Romanian label — write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
coHostRows.labelEnError: Partner {p}, link {l}: the English label — write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
coHostRows.descriptionRoError: Partner {p} — about the partnership (Română): write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
coHostRows.descriptionEnError: Partner {p} — about the partnership (English): write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
coHostRows.tooManyLinks: Partner {p}: at most {max} links on one partner
coHostRows.tooManyLinksGeneric: A partner can carry at most {max} links
coHostRows.tooMany: Partners: at most {max} on one event

editor.linksHelp: Optional, at most {max}: GPX, map, form, album, results. Share the file with “Anyone with the link”; the label is in both languages or neither.

linkRows.urlError: Link {n}: the address must start with https://
linkRows.kindError: Link {n}: choose the kind from the list
linkRows.labelRoError: Link {n}: the Romanian label — write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
linkRows.labelEnError: Link {n}: the English label — write it in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
linkRows.tooMany: Links and files: at most {max} on one event

editor.stravaEventUrlHelp: Optional: the event's address in the Strava club (strava.com/clubs/…/group_events/…). The series inherits it; one date can change its own.
editor.facebookEventUrlHelp: Optional: the event's address on Facebook (facebook.com/events/…). The series inherits it; one date can change its own.
editor.bodyHelp: Optional, in both languages or neither: the full description, with headings, lists and links. Shown at the top of the event page; the short one stays on the card.
editor.confirmationOpensDaysBefore: Participation confirmation: asked how many days before
editor.confirmationDeadlineDaysBefore: …and due how many days before (0 = at the start)
editor.confirmationWindowHelp: The first number: how many days before the start we ask for the declaration. The second: the deadline until which the place is the runner's; 0 means it never lapses.

typeNotes.GROUP_RUN: Group run: people simply turn up — no registration, no participants, no programme.
typeNotes.RACE: Race: registration, a declaration, race numbers and a programme for the day.
typeNotes.HIKE: Hike: may take registrations and have a programme, when places are limited.
typeNotes.COFFEE: Coffee: may take registrations, to book the table, and have a programme.
typeNotes.GEAR_TEST: Gear test: may take registrations and have a programme.
typeNotes.MEETUP: Other event: the one-off, with a partner or for an occasion. May take registrations and have a programme.
typeNotes.EXTERNAL: External event: it is somebody else's, and registration happens on the organizer's own page.

editor.deleteBlockedByTest: Cannot be deleted: it has {count} registrations, all of them test data. Remove those first, under “Test registrations” above.
editor.bibsOnlyTest: Numbers are given to real, confirmed registrations only. Everything here is test data, which never gets a number — for a rehearsal, add a participant at the desk.
editor.bibStartNumberHelp: 1 by default. Use 100 or 500 to give each distance its own band — numbers are given in order of confirmation, counting up from here.

reminder.label: The reminder before the start
reminder.help: The email with the time, the place, the QR code and the number, sent once to everyone confirmed. “The club's setting” ({lead}) is changed under Settings → “Deadlines”.

editor.minAgeHelp: At least {default}, reached by the day of the event. From {default} to 17, a parent or legal guardian registers the runner, and the declaration is signed by the minor and the parent.
editor.minAgeReadOnly: {age}. Changed by whoever may change the event's settings.

bibDesign.title: What the race number looks like
bibDesign.intro: What is printed on the bib, and how large. The same choices show in the preview on the “Numbers” page and on the A4 sheet you send to the printer.
bibDesign.headerImageSrc: A picture instead of the coloured band
bibDesign.headerImageSrcHelp: It runs the full width across the top. With one chosen, the band, the logo and the text on it are not printed — the picture is the header.
bibDesign.sponsorImageSrcHelp: Above the small print at the foot. Pick the part with the sponsors, or put the whole picture in the strip.

picture.failed: The picture did not upload. Try again.

cropHelp.header: Drag the rectangle over the part you want across the top of the number.
cropHelp.sponsors: Drag the rectangle over the sponsors. “The whole picture” puts all of it in the strip.

shape.header: Shape: {ratio} to 1, the size of the number's top strip.
shape.sponsors: Shape: {ratio} to 1, the size of the sponsors' strip.

footer.title: Footer
footer.intro: The small print at the foot, in the order below. What does not fit on one line goes onto a second; what does not fit there either is cut with “…” — the preview shows exactly where.
footer.showEventInFooter: The event's name and date, when the header does not show them
footer.footerTextPlaceholder: e.g. Timing: … · Organiser emergencies: 07xx xxx xxx
footer.footerTextHelp: It is printed on every number and worn in public — do not write participants' personal data.

bibDesign.previewCaption: Preview — this is how it prints
bibDesign.previewAlt: The race number as it would look with the current choices, for a runner named “Nume Prenume”
bibDesign.previewNote: The preview above changes at once; the “Numbers” page and the PDF follow a save.

editor.bibColourHelp: The band across the top of the printed number, the one carrying the club's logo and the race. “The club's colour” unless you want a specific one.
editor.createdPublished: The event was created and published. It is on the site, in both languages.
editor.createdPublishedWithSeries: The event and {dates} were created and published.
editor.createdNotPublished: The event was created as a draft but could not be published. Missing: {detail}. Nothing you typed was lost — fill it in and press “Publish”.
editor.createdNotPublishedRole: The event was created as a draft. Publishing is the Administrator's — submit it for review.
editor.createdNotPublishedOther: The event was created as a draft but could not be published: {reason}

notice.count: Participants who would get the “Updated details” email: {count}, only if the place, date, time or programme changed, or you write a note. Messages, the club's copies included: {messages} ({allowance}).
notice.countNone: Nobody is registered for this date right now, so the box sends no email.
notice.countSeries: If the change also reaches other dates of the series, their participants are told too, once each, about their own date.
notice.noteHelp: Optional, in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters each. Without it, the email goes only if the place, the date or the programme changed.
notice.cancelTitleCreate: You are creating the event as cancelled
notice.cancelIntroCreate: The event is created with the status Cancelled and shows so on the site if you publish it. No email goes out: nobody is registered for a new event.
notice.cancelReasonHelpCreate: Required, in both languages · plain text, at most {max} characters in each. It stays in the audit log, with your name.
notice.cancelIntro: The registrations stay as they are, as a record: nobody is withdrawn and no status changes. No more places are offered, no numbers are given and no automatic emails go out for this event.
notice.cancelReasonHelp: Required, in both languages · plain text, at most {max} characters each. Each participant gets it in the language they registered in; it also appears in the audit log, with your name.
notice.cancelNotify: Tell the participants that the event is cancelled
notice.cancelCount: Participants who would get the “Event cancelled” email: {count}. Messages, the club's copies included: {messages} ({allowance}).
notice.cancelCountNone: Nobody is registered right now, so no email goes out.

outcome.update: “Updated details” emails queued: {queued}. They leave through the email queue, each in the participant's language.
outcome.none: No email went out: the place, the date and time and the programme did not change, and the note for the participants was empty.
outcome.cancelled: The event is cancelled. “Event cancelled” emails queued: {queued}.
outcome.cancelledQuiet: The event is cancelled. The participants were not told, because the box was unticked.
outcome.cancelledNobody: The event is cancelled. It takes no registrations on this site, so there was nobody to email. The reason is in the audit log.

notice.countTest: Test registrations, which get the email too and are counted nowhere: {test}.
notice.noteRoError: What changed (Română): write the note in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
notice.noteEnError: What changed (English): write the note in both languages or neither, at most {max} characters
notice.cancelReasonRoError: Why the event is cancelled (Română): required in both languages, at most {max} characters
notice.cancelReasonEnError: Why the event is cancelled (English): required in both languages, at most {max} characters

editor.immediateActions: Immediate actions — they do not go through “Save”
editor.groupRunNoRegistration: A group run takes no registration — anybody simply turns up. Change the type under “What kind of event” to take registrations.
editor.groupRunNoProgramme: A group run has no programme.
editor.modeNoneSentence: The page says no registration is needed.
editor.repeatPublishOffHelp: Off: new dates are created as drafts; you publish them from the events list.
editor.repeatPublishDraftSource: While the event is a draft, new dates are drafts too.
editor.repeatRenewal: The site always keeps the next {horizon} created; the last one created: {date}.
editor.repeatAdminOnly: Only an administrator can start or stop the recurrence.
editor.repeatAllInList: All the dates ({count}) in the events list
editor.repeatRuleLiveHorizon: The dates of the next {horizon} are created now.

groups.page: The event page, top to bottom

publication.createDraft: Created as a draft: nothing appears on the site until it is published.
publication.nothingMissing: Nothing is missing: the event can be published.

risk.when: Those registered for this date ({date}) stay registered if you change it. To tell them, tick “Tell the participants” under Save.
risk.place: Those registered know the place “{place}”. If you change it, tick “Tell the participants” under Save.
risk.programme: The reminder before the start repeats the programme and every row is a calendar entry; a change is one of those “Tell the participants” sends.
risk.registration: Registrations already made stay. Places added are offered to the waiting list on save, in order.
risk.status: Cancelling stops registration and, if you leave the box ticked, tells those registered with the reason written here.

registered.reach: a change in the cards with an orange edge reaches them
registered.cards: The cards with an orange edge, where a change reaches those registered:

boxes.textsReadOnly: Texts are written by an Editor or an Administrator.
boxes.settingsReadOnly: Settings are changed by the Administrator.

kind.title: What kind of event
kind.changes: The type decides what the other boxes ask: a group run has no registration and no programme — the two boxes below say so.
kind.groupRunWarning: It has registrations ({count}) — a group run takes none, and their list leaves the page.

when.title: Date and time
when.timezoneHelp: Changed only for an event in another time zone. The times above are written in it.
when.series: On the other dates of the series, a new time lands at that time on each date's own day.

programme.title: The day's programme and what to bring

registrationWindow.title: Registration period
registrationWindow.earlierClose: An earlier close stops only new registrations.

conditions.title: Participation conditions
conditions.onlyHere: Asked only when registration is here, on the site.
conditions.onlyRegisteringTypes: A group run has no registration form, so it asks nothing.
conditions.legalLink: Legal documents — where a new version of the declaration is approved
conditions.declarationUnderRules: The minimum age and the declaration a participant signs are chosen under “Programme, rules and declaration”: the age in “Rules”, the declaration in “Self-declaration”.

confirmation.title: Confirmation window
confirmation.datesAtStart: For {date}: asked from {opens}, due at the start — the place does not lapse before the start.
confirmation.datesOff: No window: the signature is asked at registration ({hold}), as on the weekly runs.

bibs.title: Race numbers (bibs)
bibs.startChange: Numbers given stay; a new first number applies only to the numbers given from now on.

startList.title: Public participant list
startList.onlyHere: A public list exists only for registration on the site: choose “On the site” under Taking part and registration.
startList.onlyRegisteringTypes: A group run has no registration, so no public list either: change the type under “What kind of event”.

status.title: Event status
status.createNote: Scheduled by default. Choose Cancelled for an event already called off or Completed for one already held. Neither sends an email: nobody is registered yet.
status.completedRefused: Completed can only be chosen for an event that has already started; otherwise choose Scheduled or Cancelled

coHosts.title: Co-hosts — “Together with”
coHosts.note: Optional. One card per organization the club holds the event with: a sentence about the partnership, in both languages, and its links. They show under “Together with …”.

save.title: Save
save.createWithSeries: with the series' dates of the next {horizon}.

received.title: Registrations received
received.summary: real registrations: {count} · on the waiting list: {waiting}
received.summaryPlaces: real registrations: {count} · on the waiting list: {waiting} · places taken: {occupied} of {capacity}

copyDelete.title: Duplicate or delete the event
copyDelete.summary: Duplicate as a draft · delete only without registrations

preview.title: Preview
preview.summary: How it looks on the site — the card, the page and the form, without saving

summary.oneLanguage: to write in {language} too (both languages or neither)

registration.noneInvite: No registration — open to take registrations on the site

conditions.noDeclaration: Declaration missing — required for registration on the site

confirmation.sentence: Asked {opens} days before, due {due} days before
confirmation.atStart: Asked {opens} days before, due at the start
confirmation.off: No window — the signature is asked at registration

startList.shown: Public — only the names of those confirmed who chose to appear
startList.shownWithWaitlist: Public · with the waiting list — only the names of those who chose to appear

declaration.offeredNoText: declaration for {surface} — no approved text in force, the button does not show

declaration.title: Self-declaration
declaration.newest: {kind}: the newest approved version is v{version} · {title}. The participant signs it when confirming the registration.
declaration.notOnSite: No declaration is asked: the event takes no registrations on the site. Choose “Înscrieri pe site” under “Taking part and registration” to choose the declaration.
declaration.roadFallback: {kind}: no approved version yet, so a road or park race signs the mountain event declaration. Approve one under Legal documents → New version → Start from the template.
declaration.mismatch: The course is on “{surface}” and the kind chosen is “{chosen}”: “{wanted}” fits it. Choose it above, if the course is right.

identical.warning: The English text is identical to the Romanian one — is it translated?
identical.listTitle: To check: the English text is identical to the Romanian one (does not block publication)

groupRunDeclaration.label: Optional self-declaration
groupRunDeclaration.help: Optional, signed once for every date; the signer and the club each get a copy. It needs an approved privacy notice. The run declaration is signed from 18, whatever the run's minimum age.
groupRunDeclaration.notGroupSurface: Only for a group run on asphalt or on a trail: choose the surface in “The course” card.
groupRunDeclaration.missing: The club has no approved version of “{document}” yet. Approve one in Legal documents, together with a new privacy notice, then tick it here.
groupRunDeclaration.minAgeHelp: Reached by the day of the run, at least 18: the declaration covers no minor, even if this box says less. Above 18, for example 21, the signing page asks for the birth date.
groupRunDeclaration.inForce: The text in force for {surface}: “{document}”, v{version}.

pageFlow.title: The page, top to bottom
pageFlow.shareLine: Here the page puts the share buttons and the calendar — automatically, from the page's address; they have no card.

publishGaps.title: Cannot publish yet
publishGaps.intro: Publication needs these fields, in every language:
publishGaps.introSaved: Publication needs these fields, in every language, filled in and saved:

editor.participantListHelpMore: Everyone else shows as “Participant (name hidden)”. The save is refused while no approved privacy notice that describes the list is in force.
editor.confirmationWindowHelpMore: After the deadline, the place goes to the next in line only if someone is waiting. Whoever registers after the window opens, or when the first number is 0, has {hold} to sign.
editor.membersOnlyHelp: Only signed-in members see it; it is not on the public site. Existing registrations stay.
editor.waitlistAutoOffer: Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically
editor.waitlistAutoOfferHelp: On “Yes”, a freed or added place is offered at once, by email and with a deadline, to the first on the waiting list. On “No”, places stay free until you hand them out.
editor.waitlistAutoOfferHelpMore: You hand them out from the “Registration queue” with “Send them the offer”, or at the desk with “Give a place”. While anyone waits, newcomers join the list too.
editor.waitlistCountPublic: Show publicly how many are waiting
editor.waitlistCountPublicHelp: Ticked: the card, the page and each person on the list learn how many are waiting. Unticked: the pages say only that there is a waiting list and how to join it; the club sees it in the backoffice.
editor.hiddenListEnabledHelp: Ticked: registrations offer «Special guest — takes no place». Unticked: nobody new goes on the list; those on it stay, and the page mentions them while they hold a place.
editor.hiddenListEnabledMoreFor: For organizers, volunteers, pacemakers and invited runners: they are at the start without taking one of the announced places. An ordinary participant does not go here.
editor.hiddenListEnabledMoreSettings: Ticked, the list has two more settings: its own series of race numbers, and «Count the special guests too» for the public numbers. Unticked, both stop.
editor.hiddenListEnabledMoreEmail: An invitation by email is how somebody receives a link to register.
editor.hiddenListEnabledMoreDifference: The special guests list only says whether the registration takes one of the announced places; an invitation by email can also be sent «On the special guests list».
editor.hiddenListBibStart: The special guests' numbers start at
editor.hiddenListBibStartHelp: Empty: everybody's series. Set: their own series, from here up, outside the race's series; leave room above it, say 900 for 150 places. Without a limit of places, only below the race's first number.
editor.hiddenListBibStartHelpMore: The room above the race's series holds supplementary places and the desk's spares. A full series takes the next free number after it, from the other series if need be; no number is given twice.
editor.participantCountPublicHelp: Ticked: the page says how many are coming and how many are confirmed. Unticked: the list shows only the names, no numbers; the club sees the numbers in the backoffice.
editor.hiddenListCountedHelp: Ticked: “Who's coming” and “confirmed” count the special guests too. Unticked: the numbers count only the race's places; the special guests come on top.

preview.notice: Staff preview. The status of this text is: {status}. This page is not public and is not indexed.

signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.unavailable: Staff sign-in is not available in this environment yet.
signIn.developmentOnly: Development identities, on a local machine and in tests only. These are not real people.
signIn.membersLead: Sign in with the address the club made your member account for.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.inviteHelp: Adds the address to the team list and emails the invitation. The sign-in account is created by itself only with the Zitadel key set; until then, in the Zitadel console.
staff.inviteHelpSends: Adds the address to the team list, creates their sign-in account and emails them the invitation and the password link.
staff.inviteSent: Added. The invitation is on its way to their mailbox, with the link to choose a password.
staff.inviteExists: Added, the invitation is on its way. They already have a sign-in account with this address — they can sign in at /admin right away.
staff.inviteManual: Added, and the invitation is on its way, but no sign-in account was created: the Zitadel key is missing. Create it in the Zitadel console with exactly this address.
staff.inviteFailed: Added and the invitation is on its way, but the sign-in provider refused to create the account ({reason}). They can create it at the sign-in page with exactly this address.
staff.tableCaption: The accounts that may sign in to the backoffice, with each one's role
staff.empty: There is no staff account yet.
staff.resendInviteBody: An email goes to {email} with the sign-in link.
staff.passwordResetBody: Zitadel sends {email} a link to change their password. We never see the password.
staff.deactivateAccountBody: {name}'s account is switched off at the provider: they cannot sign in anywhere. The row in Echipa stays.
staff.revokeBody: {name} can no longer open the backoffice. The provider account stays — deactivate it separately if they are leaving the club.
staff.roleHelp: Each role can do what the one below it can, plus what it says here. Volunteers see the desk only.

roles.CONTRIBUTOR: the desk: scans codes, marks people present, confirms on paper, gives a free place, types a number. That is all.
roles.COPYWRITER: the words: descriptions, rules, programmes and the site's pages, in both languages. No settings, no publishing.
roles.MODERATOR: registrations and race day: reads the events, the registrations, the export and the numbers, messages the participants, works the desk, keeps the gallery. Creates, sets up and publishes no event.
roles.DEV: the technical page /devs, to diagnose. Creates and sets up no event; sees no participant data.
roles.ADMIN: runs the club: creates, sets up, publishes and cancels the events; plus registrations, the export, the legal texts, the emails, the tasks, the plans and the team.
roles.SUPERADMIN: plus the technical settings that can stop the service — how often the site checks, the database's limits, the anti-bot check — and naming another Superadministrator.
roles.MEMBER: the members' area of the site, after signing in. No backoffice.

staff.resendFailed: The invitation did not go out: the identity provider has no account with this address ({reason}). Check the address in the table — if it is wrong, withdraw access and add the person again with the right one.
staff.passwordResetSent: Done. They have been emailed the link for setting a new password.
staff.accountDeactivated: The sign-in account is deactivated: they can no longer sign in anywhere. The team row stays — to take their access away too, use “Withdraw access”.
staff.accountReactivated: The sign-in account is active again.
staff.accountMissing: The identity provider has no account with this address, so there was nothing to change. Check the address in the table.
staff.accountUnconfigured: This needs the Zitadel key: Tasks → Club → “Invite the team”. Until then, from the Zitadel console.
staff.noAccountHelp: “No sign-in account”: the person is on the list but cannot sign in. The fix: ⋮ → “Revoke access”, then “Add” again with the same address.
staff.accountsBlind: Could not check who has an account: the Zitadel key sees only {seen} accounts, so it lacks the “Org User Manager” role. See Tasks → Club → “The invitation key”.
staff.accountsUnchecked: Could not check who has a sign-in account — Zitadel answered: {reason}. The rows below say nothing about accounts until a check succeeds; reload the page in a few minutes.
staff.inviteKeyMissing: Sign-in accounts cannot be created: the Zitadel key (ZITADEL_MANAGEMENT_PAT) is missing. Until it is set, create the account in the Zitadel console, with exactly the address in the table.
staff.inviteAsideSends: the account and the invitation, in one step
staff.inviteAsideManual: the list and the invitation; the account, in Zitadel's console
staff.superadminRow: Only a Superadministrator changes a Superadministrator's role and access.
staff.membersAside: one address per row, the Member role
staff.membersRowsHelp: The address, or the name and the address: “Ana Pop, ana@example.com”. At most {max} rows at a time. One row that is not an address stops them all. A member already added only gets their account again.
staff.membersInvited: Members added: {count}. The invitations are on their way.
staff.membersInviteFailed: Members added: {count}, the invitations are on their way — but for {failed} of them the sign-in account could not be made. Press “Add the members” again with their addresses to retry.
staff.membersRetried: Already members: {retried} — only their account was tried again.

membersOutcome.invited: the account existed, invitation sent again
membersOutcome.unconfigured: no invitation key: the account is made in the Zitadel console

queue.title: The registration queue
queue.holdsHelp: “Held” are the places kept while somebody signs the declaration ({hold}) or answers an offer ({offer}). Free = places − confirmed − held.
queue.lineEmpty: Nobody is waiting. The list fills once the places are gone.
queue.lineNone: This event has no waiting list: once the places are gone, registration stops.
queue.offeredQueued: offer; its deadline runs from when the email leaves
queue.orderSubmitted: In the order the forms were sent (places are given out by hand).
queue.orderLine: In the order they joined the list, the order the system offers places in.
queue.interestTitle: Addresses waiting for the opening notice: {count}
queue.interestHelp: The addresses left at “Tell me”: each gets one email when registration opens. Type here the address of someone who no longer wants the message.
queue.interestRemoved: The address was removed from the notification list.
queue.interestNotFound: That address was not on this event's list. Check whether they wrote from another one.
queue.simulate: To try the waiting list (not in production): set a few places, add more test registrations than that, then cancel a confirmed one.
queue.simulateMore: The first registrations take the places, held for {hold} each; the rest queue in order. A lapsed hold or more places also gives the first in line the offer; its email shows in the Outbox.
queue.holdsHelpMore: A lapsed hold stays the person's, and is released only when somebody is waiting for a place or when the event starts.
queue.familyQueued: reserved until {until}, a deadline fixed by the family's first form; the family's email has not left yet and does not move it
queue.familyQueuedNoDeadline: reserved; the family's email has not left yet

familyHeld.one: {count} place held by a family for a form with no registration, until the family's deadline
familyHeld.few: {count} places held by families for forms with no registration, until their deadlines
familyHeld.other: {count} places held by families for forms with no registration, until their deadlines

bulkResend.button: Resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed
bulkResend.help: A new signing link for every registration waiting for its declaration; skips those with an email in the last hour or still queued.
bulkResend.nobody: Nobody is waiting to sign the declaration.
bulkResend.confirmTitle: Resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed?
bulkResend.body: {waiting}; {skipped}: {recent} with an email in the last hour or still queued, {limited} at the resend limit. Each gets a new link — the old one stops working. The emails leave at the road's pace.
bulkResend.done: Queued: {queued} · skipped: {skipped} — {recent} with a recent email, {limited} at the resend limit.

testRegistrations.title: Test registrations
testRegistrations.explanation: Test participants on @test.invalid addresses that receive no mail. They take places like real people but stay out of the export. Not in production.

stoppedAtLimit.one: {created} test registration added; the rest were refused because the places and the waiting list filled up — exactly as a real registration would be.
stoppedAtLimit.few: {created} test registrations added; the rest were refused because the places and the waiting list filled up — exactly as a real registration would be.
stoppedAtLimit.other: {created} test registrations added; the rest were refused because the places and the waiting list filled up — exactly as a real registration would be.

legal.title: Legal documents
legal.intro: The privacy notice, the terms, the race declarations for a mountain event and for a road or park event, the two group-run declarations: {count} texts. A correction is a new version.

whatIs.PRIVACY_NOTICE: GDPR: what data we take from participants, why and for how long. Ticked at registration.
whatIs.TERMS: The rules of the site and of registering, not the race rules — those are on the event's page. Ticked at registration.
whatIs.EVENT_DECLARATION: The declaration of a mountain event, on mountain or forest trails: age, minors, the course's risks, health. Signed when the place is confirmed.
whatIs.GROUP_RUN_DECLARATION_ASPHALT: Optional, for a group run on asphalt; signed on the run's page, once for every date of it. Approve it together with a new privacy notice.
whatIs.GROUP_RUN_DECLARATION_TRAIL: Optional, for a group run on a trail; signed on the run's page, once for every date of it. Approve it together with a new privacy notice.
whatIs.EVENT_DECLARATION_ROAD: The declaration of a road or park event, with the risks of asphalt and traffic. Until you approve it, these events sign the mountain event declaration.

legal.empty: No legal document exists. Registration is refused until an approved privacy notice exists.
legal.emptyCanCreate: No legal document exists yet, so registration is refused. Start with the privacy notice: New version.
