Under «The registration's journey», «What to tell them» has the sentences to say, in the language they registered in: the same words they read on their page and in the emails, with their deadline — and until when the email's link is valid, only when that is another time than the deadline.
«Copy» puts them on the clipboard, for a message. The block shows no address and no link: a link goes only by email, with «Resend email».

tasks.title: Download the list (Excel or CSV)
steps: «Registrations» → pick the event → «Filter».
Tick «Only with offers and benefits» to see only who said yes to offers; the export follows the filter.
Press «Export to Excel» (or «Export CSV»). The file holds exactly the filtered rows, without test registrations.
The file carries identity documents and phone numbers: never send it to a group, and delete it within 7 days of the event.

tasks.title: Add a registration for someone who asked
steps: «Registrations» → «Add a registration».
Under «Event» pick the event.
Fill in the person's details, «Participant email address» and «Language we write to them in».
Tick «I confirm this person asked me to register them…».
The person is not in front of you? Leave «This person is at the desk…» unticked: they get the email and sign their own declaration.
Press «Add the registration» and confirm in the window.
Refused because the address already has a registration: the family's second person registers from the public form (see “A family on one address”).

tasks.title: Download and print the race numbers
steps: «Events» → «Open» on the race.
Open the «Taking part and registration» card, then «Allocate and print».
«See the bibs» to check them on screen.
«Download every number (PDF)»: two A5 numbers on each A4 sheet, with the cut line. «One per page» for a single one, centred on A4.
Print at actual size (100%) and cut on the line.
Numbers go in order of confirmation, from «Race numbers (BIB) start at». «Assign numbers» is the Administrator's.
The desk's spares: «Reprint the free spares (PDF)» prints again the ones not yet given. Only the Administrator reserves new spare numbers.

On the site, the «Who's coming» list shows the «BIB» column once the club approves the new privacy notice. Before that, the Administrator writes to those already registered with «Send a message to participants»; anyone who does not want to appear presses «I do not want to appear on the participants & results list» in «My registrations», and the number leaves with the name. From the approval on, the column shows the number of every confirmed runner who has one, whichever notice they registered under; a confirmed runner without one shows “—”.

tasks.title: A chosen number for someone
steps: «Registrations» → open the person's registration.
Press «Change the number»; the free numbers are listed under the box. No such button? The number is already final and is not changed from here.
Type the number, press «Save no.» and confirm. The person gets the number by email. A number somebody else already wears is refused.

tasks.title: Send a message to the participants
steps: «Events» → «Open» → the «Registrations received» card → «Send a message to participants».
Under «Who receives it» pick the group (everyone, «Only the confirmed», the waiting list or those without a declaration) and see how many they are.
Write the «Subject» and the «Message», in Romanian and in English.
Under «How the email looks» read both versions: «Registered in Romanian» and «Registered in English».
Press «Send the message», then «Send» in the window. The message stays under «Messages sent».
About this event only: no advertising, no sponsors' offers, no other events.

tasks.title: Write to the newsletter's subscribers
steps: Press «Newsletter» in the top bar. «Numbers and sends» shows how many confirmed subscribers there are, per topic, and what was sent; the addresses are in the «Subscribers» card.
Under «Write to the subscribers» choose the topic under «What it is about» and see how many receive it.
On the «Română» tab write «Subject (Romanian)» and the text: headings, lists, links and pictures, as in a document.
Press «Translate this card: RO → EN», then read and correct the «English» tab.
Under «How it looks» read the email in both languages.
Press «Send the newsletter» and confirm. The message stays under «Sent», with its first line. New-event announcements leave by themselves.

tasks.title: See who subscribed
steps: «Newsletter» → open the «Subscribers» card. Its line says how many are confirmed and how many pending.
Search under «Search the address» or choose «Topic» and «State», then press «Filter». «Download CSV» takes the list as filtered.
The «Participants who ticked offers and benefits» card: who ticked it when registering, with the address, the event and the date. «Download CSV» takes all of it. It is not the newsletter.

«Download the list for sponsors (Excel)»: the same people as the CSV, with every tick of each (offers, the public list, socials, terms, declaration, state) — for the club. Give the partner «Download CSV»: first name, last name, address, event and date. Only consents given under a notice that allows it. Note whom you give the file to; delete it within 30 days.
Removing an address is the Administrator's: tell them who asked.

tasks.title: Get race day ready
steps: Print the numbers (see above).
«Events» → «Open» → «Registrations received»: print a few «Paper declaration form (PDF)» and, if it is there, «Paper declaration form for a minor (PDF)».
There too, «Emergency sheet»: the phones and emergency contacts of everyone confirmed, on one page. Take it to the race and destroy it afterwards.
Volunteers: ask an administrator to make their accounts with the Voluntar role, then show them this guide's “Race day” section.
On race day: «Race day» in the top bar.

tasks.title: A change to the event
steps: «Events» → «Open»: see the event with all its cards, without «Save».
Write to the Administrator what must change: the date, the place, the route, the cost, the places, the registration or the texts. Only they tell the participants about it.

tasks.title: The signed declarations
steps: All of an event's: «Events» → «Open» → «Registrations received» → «Signed declarations (PDF)».
One person's: open the registration → «Signed declaration (PDF)».
They carry identity documents: keep them only in the club's archive.

tasks.title: What the Administrator does, not you
steps: Creating, changing, publishing, duplicating and cancelling events, and telling the participants about a change.

Cancelling or erasing registrations, resending emails (and the declaration to everyone who has not signed), sending waiting-list offers («Send them the offer»), «Assign numbers», marking numbers printed and sending the thank-you. Tell them what needs doing.

sections.title: Administrator — events, registrations, emails
sections.who: Role: Administrator or Superadministrator. Only you create, set up, publish and cancel the events; the Redactor writes their texts.

tasks.title: Create an event
steps: «Events» → «New event».
Each card is a part of the public page, in the site's order. The map at the top, «The page, top to bottom», takes you to each card.
«What kind of event» → «Event type» (Race, Group run and the others).
«Title and summary»: «Title» and «Summary», in the «Română» tab and in the «English» tab.
«When and where»: the date and time, then the meeting point in both languages, the address, the map link. Place not known yet? Tick «Location to be announced».
The other cards as needed: «Event description» (a YouTube film goes here, with the «Add a YouTube film» button), «The course», «Taking part and registration», «Programme, rules and declaration».
«Create the event» saves it as a draft (not on the site). «Create and publish» puts it on the site at once.
Something required missing? «Cannot publish yet» appears at the top, each gap a link: fill it in and press again.
The usual mistake: leaving the «English» tab empty leaves the event with no English half; or pressing «Create the event» thinking it went live — it stays a draft, unlike «Create and publish».

tasks.title: Edit an event
steps: «Events» → «Edit» on its row.
A closed card says on its line what is missing, per language. Open the card and change what is needed.
Write in «Română» and in «English»: an optional text is written in both languages or neither.
At the bottom, in the «Save» card, on a published event tick «I understand that I am editing published content.».
A date of a series: under «Save for:» pick «This date only», «This and the following dates» or «All dates of the series».
Press «Save». It is on the site at once, in both languages.
The usual mistake: picking «This date only» when you meant the whole series (or the other way round) — check the message under «Save for:» before you press «Save».

tasks.title: The club's difficulty scale
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → the «What kind of event» card: pick «Difficulty» (the band) and, beside it, «Level» — one of the band's three.

The scale has 15 levels, in order: easy 1–3, medium 4–6, fairly hard 7–9, hard 10–12, very hard 13–15. On the site the pill shows the band alone, "Medium"; the gauge's dots show the level within the band.
What each band and level means: press the question mark beside «Difficulty» or «Level».
The level in the other bands: the first when the route sits at the easy end of its band, the third when it is close to the next one (longer, steeper, at night, mud). Not sure? The middle one.
The site's filter ticks a whole band: «Hard» shows all three of its levels, 10–12, and writes them beside its name.
Forgot the scale? The question mark beside «Level» shows all of it.
On the site, the difficulty pill says the level on a tap, for example "Medium — level 5 of 15", and under it the whole scale: easy 1–3 · medium 4–6 · fairly hard 7–9 · hard 10–12 · very hard 13–15.

tasks.title: The English in one press
steps: Write every box in Romanian: the title, the summary, the description, the rules, the route, the programme.

At the top of the editor (event, page, album, team card) press «Copy and translate everything: RO → EN». Every text goes, translated, into its English twin, with the same layout. If the English already has text, it asks, naming how many and which: «Replace everything» or «Only the empty ones»; for a very long text it also says how many characters of today's budget will be sent. Is the button grey? The server has no DeepL key yet: «See the steps», under the button, opens the row under Tasks → Club. The key has a credit of 1,000,000 characters, given once and not renewed monthly: what is left is under Settings → Costs, and once it is spent the button stays grey and says so, with a link to Costs.
Read the English and correct what reads wrong.
Press «Save». The translate press saves nothing: until «Save», nothing changes on the site.

tasks.title: Put a picture in the summary or the description
steps: Open the card («Title and summary» or «Event description») and put the cursor where the picture goes.
Press «Picture» in the editor's toolbar.
Under «Quality» leave «Medium (recommended)».
Press «Choose the picture» and pick the file. A picture already uploaded comes from «From gallery».
Write «What the picture shows (alt text)», then «Done».
Press «Save». To replace a picture: press it, «Remove the picture», then put in the new one.

tasks.title: Publish an event, or take it off the site
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → the «Publication» card.
A draft: press «Publică» (publish) — it goes live in one press, no «Trimite spre verificare» (submit for review) first.
In the window press «Publică» again. Both languages go live together.
Something missing? «Cannot publish yet» appears with the list: fill it in, «Save», then «Publică».
Several at once: on the «Events» list tick them and press «Publish the ticked ones».
To take it off the site: «Mută în ciornă» (back to draft). Once it has happened: «Arhivează» (archive).

tasks.title: Repeat an event (a weekly series)
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → the «Recurrence» card.
Tick «Repeat this event», pick the days and until when.
Press «Create the dates» and confirm.

The site creates the new dates by itself, {horizon} ahead. Those created as drafts show on the «Events» list with «Publish» on the row; «Publish automatically from now on» publishes them by themselves from now on.
A copy, not a series: on the list, «More actions» (⋮) → «Duplicate». The copy is a draft.

tasks.title: Open registration for a race
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → the «Taking part and registration» card.
«Registration mode» → «Înscrieri pe site» (registration on the site).

«Capacity» and, beside it, «Waiting list»: «Unlimited», «Limited to a number of places», with as many people as you type, or «No waiting list». Under «Limited…», empty or 0 makes it unlimited; only «No waiting list» closes the list. Below them, «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically»: «Yes» gives every freed or added place to the first on the list; «No» if you want to choose (see “Choose who gets a freed place”).
«Registration period»: «Registration opens» and «Registration closes».
«Confirmation window»: «Participation confirmation: asked how many days before» and, in the box beside it, how many days before it is due (0 = the place never lapses before the start).

«Programme, rules and declaration» → «Rules»: «Minimum age to take part» (14 unless you change it, never under 14), on every type of event. The declaration: «Programme, rules and declaration» → «Self-declaration» → «Declaration a participant signs».
«Race numbers (bibs)»: «Race numbers (BIB) start at».
Press «Save», then publish the event. Nobody can register while the terms, the privacy notice and the declaration are not approved.

tasks.title: Choose who gets a freed place
steps: «Events» → «Edit» on the race's row → the «Taking part and registration» card.
Under «Places from the waiting list are allocated automatically» choose «No» and press «Save». On «No», a freed or added place stays free until you hand it out.

No need to raise «Capacity»: when no place is free, «Send them the offer» adds one supplementary place once you confirm (the capacity grows by one, and the registration's trail says who added it and for whom).
The «Registrations received» card → «Registration queue»: on the named person's waiting-list row press «Send them the offer». The same button is on their registration's page too.

The window says until when they have and, when no place is free, that you add one; press «Send them the offer» or, on a full event, «Add a place and send the offer». They get the ordinary «A place has freed up» email, with the ordinary deadline, {offer}: from the email they press «Confirm the place» and sign the declaration, if they have not yet.
Not accepted in time? The offer lapses and the place is free again until you give it.
A place added with «Add a place and send the offer» stays in the capacity: unused, on «Yes» and before registration closes it goes to the first in line; otherwise it stays free until you give it.

It works at any moment until the start, after registration closes too: the offer then holds until the start at the latest. At the desk, with the person there, «Give a place» confirms them on the paper declaration, but only into a free place; on a full event an “i” beside it says why.

The others stay on the waiting list and receive nothing. On the site, the card says «Places are given from the waiting list», and newcomers join the list too while anyone waits. How many may wait is «Waiting list», beside «Capacity».
Mind the end of the line: once nobody is left on the waiting list — somebody holding an offer is no longer on it —, the places still free go to whoever registers next.

tasks.title: Give a place to someone who did not confirm the address
steps: Open the registration: it says «Awaiting email confirmation» (the email never arrived, went to Spam, or the places were full when they pressed the link).
Press «Give them a place now». The window names the address you vouch for; press «Give them a place now» again or, on a full event, «Add a place and give it to them».
The person gets the place and the declaration email at once, with the deadline in it. The old confirmation link no longer confirms anything, and a confirmation email still queued is not sent.
They sign the declaration: online, from the email, or on paper at the desk, where the volunteer presses «Confirm on paper». Nobody signs the declaration for them.

When no place is free, the window says beforehand that you add one supplementary place over the limit and what the capacity becomes; there is no need to raise «Capacity» or to set the automatic allocation to «No».
The added place is theirs in the same press: it never reaches the waiting list. The registration's trail says who added it, for whom, and from how many to how many.
The people on the waiting list stay where they are. Check the address first: a wrong address holds the place until the deadline.

tasks.title: Special guests: organizers, pacemakers, volunteers
steps: For organizers, volunteers, pacemakers and invited runners: at the start without taking an announced place. It is not for an ordinary participant and hides nobody.
First, in the event's settings, under «Public participant list», tick «Use the special guests list».
Open the person's registration → «Special guests list» → choose «Special guest — takes no place» and confirm.
If they held a place, it frees up: on «Yes» it goes to the first on the waiting list; on «No» it stays free until you hand it out.
From the waiting list or an open offer they get a place now, as a special guest: the declaration email, with the usual deadline, not the offer's.
Confirmed or with a declaration to sign, they keep their state, number and emails. They appear on the public list only if they ticked, unmarked.
With «The special guests' numbers start at» the special guests have their own series of race numbers, in confirmation order; a number already given stays.
On the site, «Who's coming» counts them only with «Count the special guests too» ticked; the places and the free places never count them.
«Show the count publicly», beside «Show publicly how many are waiting», is on every event: unticked, «Who's coming» shows only the names, no numbers.
While the special guests list is in use or anybody on it holds a place, the page says beside the places, naming nobody, that organisers and invited runners may start outside the advertised places.
«Counted among the event's places» turns it back only if a place is free; otherwise the press is refused and says who holds the places.
In the registrations list, each wears the label «Special guest», and the special guests' pill shows them all; the export has a column for them.

tasks.title: Invite somebody to an event, by email
steps: For members, partners and guests: each gets an email with a link to the form, with the name and address already filled in.
«Events» → «Edit» on the race's row → the «Registrations received» card → «Send invitations»: the list's «Invitations» section opens.

Tick members from the list or type other people, one per line: the name, then the address. Choose «Days until it expires» and «Language of the invitation» (for new addresses); tick «On the special guests list (takes no place)» for organizers, volunteers and pacemakers. You can send after registration closes too, until the start.
«Send the invitations» asks first: how many invitations, how many places are free and, on a full race, how many supplementary places are added and what the capacity becomes.
Each invitation holds a place until its deadline; if it is not accepted, the place frees up by itself. The person fills in the rest and signs the declaration themselves.
On the invitation's row: «Resend» sends a new link; the deadline stays, unless you type a number of days that moves it later. «Withdraw» closes it and frees the place.

If somebody invited registers anyway, through the public form or at the desk, their registration takes the invitation's place once their address is confirmed or they are given a place: the invitation reads «Accepted».

tasks.title: Tell the participants about a change
steps: Change the place, the time or the programme in their card.
In the «Save» card tick «Tell participants about the change».
Write «What changed (optional)» in Romanian and in English.
Press «Save». The window says how many get an email; press «Save» again.
The email goes only if the place, the start or the programme changed, or if you wrote a note.

tasks.title: Cancel an event
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → the «Event status» card (at the bottom, among the cards that are not on the page).
Under «Event status» pick «Anulat» (cancelled).
The «Save» card shows «You are cancelling the event»: write «Why the event is cancelled» in Romanian and in English.
Tick «Tell the participants that the event is cancelled». Without the tick no email goes out.
Press «Save». The red window says how many get an email; press «Save» again.

tasks.title: Correct, cancel or erase a registration
steps: «Registrations» → find the person → press their name.
A wrong name, phone or other answer: «The registration's answers» → «Change the answers», correct the box → «Save the answers».

Not coming any more: «Cancel the registration», write the «Reason», press «Cancel the registration» and confirm. The place goes to the first on the waiting list; if the event's places are not allocated automatically, it stays free until you hand it out.
The email never arrived: «Resend email» → «Send now, without waiting for the scheduled round». It works on the waiting list too: the email says where the line stands now.
They ask for their data to be erased: «Delete permanently», write the «Reason for deletion», tick «I confirm this deletion is permanent» and press «Delete permanently».
Several at once: tick the rows on the list → «Cancel the ticked ones».

tasks.title: Correct a registration's answers
steps: When: the person mistyped their name, date of birth, phone, city, club or anything else on the form, or ticked that they are a member without being one.
«Registrations» → press the name → «The registration's answers» → «Change the answers». Change only what is wrong → «Save the answers»; the question names the person and the fields.
Not changed here: the email address (cancel and add again), the consents (you only withdraw them, with their own button) and the declaration (only the person signs it).
No email is sent and no place moves. Every field changed stays in the log, with its old and new value.

tasks.title: Clear the member tick of those with no account
steps: When: before a members' race, so that only the club's members stay ticked. The participant ticks it on the form; the club does not check it.
One at a time: in «The registration's answers» untick the member tick → «Save the answers». On the list, «Not a member» is in the row's ⋮ menu.
All at once: «Registrations» → «Search and filter» → tick «Only {club} members (declared)» → «Filter» → «Member ticks with no member account».
The list shows the ticked registrations whose address is no account's on «Staff». A member registered with another address appears too: untick their row. Then «Clear the ticks on all» … and confirm.
What it does not do: it cancels no registration, moves no place and sends no email. The club on the list is cleared only if the tick had set it. Every change stays in the log.

tasks.title: What to tell someone who asks
steps: Someone asks where their registration stands — on the phone, by message or at the desk: «Registrations» → search the name → open the registration. The Administrator and the Organizer see it alike.

Under «The registration's journey», «What to tell them» has the sentences to say, in the language they registered in: the same words they read on their page and in the emails, with their deadline — and until when the email's link is valid, only when that is another time than the deadline.
«Copy» puts them on the clipboard, for a message. The block shows no address and no link: a link goes only by email, with «Resend email».

tasks.title: Resend the declaration to those who have not signed
steps: «Events» → «Edit» on the race's row → the «Registrations received» card.
Above the queue press «Resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed». The button is grey when nobody waits: under it it says «Nobody is waiting to sign the declaration.»

The window says how many are waiting to sign and how many it skips: those whose declaration email left in the last hour or is still queued, and those at the resend limit. Read it, then press «Resend the declaration to everyone who has not signed» again.
«Queued:» appears at the top with how many get the email and how many were skipped. The emails leave through the sending queue, at its pace (see “Emails are late, or Mailgun refused”).
Mind: each gets a new link, and the link in the earlier email stops working. Tell them to open the newest email.
Tell them to look for the email in Spam and in Promotions too.
At most three presses an hour per event. An “i” beside the button says when a press would be refused: the event is cancelled, finished or has started, or the hour's presses are spent.
Who loses a place, and when: a race's list in «Registrations» says under «Who has signed up» how long people keep a place and what follows the deadline; «Until when» has each one's day and time.
One person only: open their registration → «Resend email».

tasks.title: Assign the numbers and mark them printed
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → «Taking part and registration» → «Allocate and print».
Press «Assign numbers» and confirm: every confirmed registration without a number gets the next free one; numbers already given stay.
«Registrations» → pick the race → «Filter». On the same page you download the unprinted numbers, print them, then press the button that marks them printed.
The numbers for printing are two A5 on each A4 sheet (see “Download and print the race numbers” under Organizer).

tasks.title: Spare numbers for people who register at the desk
steps: «Events» → «Edit» → «Taking part and registration» → «Allocate and print» → «Spare bibs for on-the-spot entries».
In «How many» type how many blank numbers you want, then press «Print» and confirm. The window says which number they start from: from then on nobody who registers online gets them.
Press «Download the sheet» and print it. Each number has an empty name line; at the desk the name is written on in marker, and the form suggests the next free number.
Need them again? «Reprint the free spares (PDF)» puts only the numbers not yet given on the sheet and reserves no more.

tasks.title: The Mailgun plan, before and after a race
steps: First pay for the plan in the Mailgun account.
«Settings» → «Emails» → «The Mailgun plan, and how much we can still send».
Under «The plan the Mailgun account is on» pick Basic; under «Note (why, until when)» write why and until when.

«Hourly limit»: how many emails leave through Mailgun in an hour; the rest wait in the queue and leave on their own, none lost. While Mailgun keeps the account limited, write 90 (the text under the box asks the same); on QA, which shares the domain with production, set much less, about 10. Once Mailgun lifts the limit, raise the number or clear the box.
Press «Save the plan» and confirm. The figures on «Costs», the «Sent in the last hour:» line and the «Send now» button follow it.

Further down, «How emails leave: Mailgun or the club's Gmail»: for each group of emails choose «Mailgun» or «The club's Gmail». Gmail costs nothing, but Google blocks bulk sending: under each group it says what is recommended.
«Gmail limit per day (recipients)» and «Pause between two Gmail messages (seconds)» say how much leaves through Gmail, and how slowly. Press «Save the routes» and confirm.

«Settings» → «Costs» → «What it costs»: each service per month and per year, with the totals. Took Vercel Pro for the race? On the same page, under «The Vercel plan» pick Pro, then «Save the Vercel plan» and confirm; the day you drop it, Hobby.
After the race: cancel in Mailgun, then put Free back here and «Save the plan». Under «Hourly limit» keep what Mailgun asks of you.

tasks.title: Emails are late, or Mailgun refused
steps: «Settings» → «Emails». Under «The Mailgun plan, and how much we can still send», the «Sent in the last hour:» line says how many left through Mailgun in the last hour, out of the «Hourly limit». When the hour is full, the rest waits in the queue and leaves on its own once the hour has room. Nothing is lost.
Open «The sending queue»: «In the queue:» says how many wait, and each row says when it leaves. A red row, «Late: it should have left already…», is past its time.

Mailgun asked for a pause, because we are sending too fast: on the row, «The provider's last answer:» starts with “paused by the provider”. The emails through Mailgun wait as long as Mailgun asked, spending no attempt, then leave on their own.

«Send now» sends what is due at once. It helps for the emails through the club's Gmail and while Mailgun's hour has room; while the hour is full or the pause lasts it sends nothing through Mailgun, however often you press — and under the button or in a banner it says why.
To participants who ask: the email is coming, only later; they should look in Spam and in Promotions too. Those without their declaration link: “Resend the declaration to those who have not signed”.

Write to a Superadministrator (or the club's owner), with a picture of the screen, if a row shows «Stopped after every attempt», if the red rows are still there an hour later, or if «Sent in the last hour:» stays at 0 while the queue grows.

tasks.title: Remove an address from the newsletter
steps: When someone asks in writing to stop receiving the news: «Newsletter» → «Remove an address at someone's request».
Type the address under «Email address», press «Remove from the newsletter» and confirm. The address is deleted, with its topics.

tasks.title: See, search and unsubscribe the subscribers
steps: «Newsletter» → open the «Subscribers» card. Its line says how many are confirmed and how many pending; the newest address comes first.
Type the address, whole or part of it, under «Search the address». Choose «Topic» and «State» if you like, then press «Filter». «Clear the filters» shows the whole list again.
Under «Pending», the row says until when the confirmation link works, or «The link has expired.» An address never confirmed is deleted by itself.
«Download CSV» takes the list as filtered, with the same columns. Keep the file only as long as you need it, then delete it.
To remove someone, at their request: «Unsubscribe» on their row, then confirm. The address is deleted with its topics, as when the person unsubscribes.
The «Participants who ticked offers and benefits» card: who ticked it when registering, with the address, the event and the date. «Download CSV» takes all of it. It is not the newsletter.

«Download the list for sponsors (Excel)»: the same people as the CSV, with every tick of each (offers, the public list, socials, terms, declaration, state) — for the club. Give the partner «Download CSV»: first name, last name, address, event and date. Only consents given under a notice that allows it. Note whom you give the file to; delete it within 30 days.

tasks.title: The club's deadlines
steps: «Settings» → «Deadlines».
Change the numbers (the email link, the held place, the waiting-list offer, the reminder, check-in, the series).
Press «Save the deadlines» and confirm. Only what is given from now on takes the new deadlines.

tasks.title: The thank-you after a race
steps: «Events» → under «State» choose «Ended» and «Apply» → «Edit» → «Registrations received» → «Thank-you after the race».
Under «Link (optional)» put the address of the photos or the results.
Press «Send the thank-you» and confirm. It goes once, to everyone marked present.

tasks.title: Pages and the gallery
steps: A page: «Pages» → «New page» (or an existing one) → write in both languages → «Save». On the pages list, the ⋮ menu on its row → «Publish».
An album: «Gallery» → «New album» → the date, the event, the title in both languages → «New album».
On the album's page: «Upload photos», with «Quality» «Medium (recommended)»; pick a «Cover».
On the albums list, the ⋮ menu on its row → «Publish the album». An album with no photos is not published.

tasks.title: Who receives the messages from the contact page
steps: «Pages» → «Contact» → «Who receives the contact messages».
Under «To» write who receives the message. Under «CC», who gets a visible copy. Under «BCC», who gets a copy without appearing.
Addresses separated by commas, spaces or on separate lines. Press «Save the recipients» and confirm; the saved list shows on the card.

tasks.title: What the club still has to do
steps: «Tasks» → the «Club» tab: every row is read from the system, with the steps under it. A green row is done.
«Settings» → «Costs»: what the club pays and the database's limits. The brakes there are a Superadministrator's to change (their section of this guide).

tasks.title: Accounts for volunteers and colleagues
steps: «Staff» is the Administrator's and the Superadministrator's. The Superadministrator role and a Superadministrator's row are changed only by a Superadministrator.
«Staff» → «Add someone»: «Email address», «Name», «Role» (Voluntar for the desk), «Preferred language».
Press «Add» and confirm. The person gets the invitation by email and chooses a password.
It never arrived: on their row, «Resend the invitation» → «Send now, without waiting for the scheduled round».
Another role: «Change role». Left the team: «Revoke access».

tasks.title: Club members and the members' area
steps: A member has an account but no backoffice: after «Sign in» they see the members' area alone.
«Staff» → «Add someone», «Role» «Membru», or «Add several members» for a list. Press «Add» and confirm; the member gets the invitation by email.

The words: «Pages» → «Standard pages» → «Members». «Members' benefits» is the public page with the sign-in button; «The members' area» is what a member sees after signing in. Both in Romanian and English.
Put the page on the site: «Publish the page» (the Administrator only).

sections.title: Superadministrator — the technical settings
sections.who: Role: Superadministrator. Everything the Administrator does, plus the settings that can stop the service.

tasks.title: The brake on the scheduled jobs
steps: Role needed: Superadministrator. An Administrator sees the current figures but does not change the interval.
«Settings» → «Costs» → «How often the site checks».

“On demand” is the default — the site wakes the database only when it has something to do. A longer interval lowers the Neon bill, but delays every hand-over of a waiting-list place and every email the jobs send.

tasks.title: The database's limits
steps: Role needed: Superadministrator. A wrong limit can stop the site; an Administrator sees it but does not change it.
«Settings» → «Costs» → «The database's limits».

The brakes on the Neon bill, set in Neon itself, on each environment. The maximum size bounds a spike of load — the usual bill is the time the database is awake. A monthly CU-hour limit stops the database when it is reached, until the next period, and the whole site with it; the recommendation is a limit with room on every environment, with Neon's spending notification beside it, and on production a new or changed limit needs a ticked box.

tasks.title: This month's budget thresholds
steps: Role needed: Superadministrator. An Administrator sees the budget and what the site is doing, but does not change the thresholds.
«Settings» → «Costs» → «This month's budget» → «Save the thresholds».

The thresholds say at what share of the monthly limit the site turns amber and red and brakes itself. One set too low brakes it for nothing; one set too high lets it reach the limit, and then Neon stops the database.

tasks.title: The anti-bot check
steps: Role needed: Superadministrator. An Administrator sees its state but does not change it.
«Settings» → «Anti-bot»: the Cloudflare Turnstile check and the hidden honeypot trap.
Off, the form is open to robots; on with a wrong key, it can refuse real people. Switch it off on the day the box refuses people, and back on afterwards.

tasks.title: Another Superadministrator
steps: Role needed: Superadministrator.
«Staff»: only a Superadministrator makes somebody else a Superadministrator, changes a Superadministrator's role or takes their access away.
The last Superadministrator cannot be demoted or removed — whoever takes the site over is named first.

sections.title: Legal documents and personal data (GDPR)
sections.who: Role: Administrator or Superadministrator. Read once, before the first race with registrations.

tasks.title: Approve a new version of a legal text
steps: «Legal documents» → «New version».

Under «Start from the template» pick the document, from «General documents», «Race declarations» or «Group run declarations». Under each button is what is in force; «New template» shows that the text in force does not have the current template's words.
The text comes with the club's details filled in. Whatever is left in angle brackets, shaped <…>, you fill in in Romanian and in English.
Read all of it and press «Save draft».
On the draft's page: «Download PDF» to read it on paper or give it to a lawyer.
Under «Approve this version» tick «I confirm the club has approved this text and it may become public», press «Approve and publish» and confirm.
An approved text never changes. A correction is the next version: «Start the next version from this one».

tasks.title: The club's legal texts
steps: «Legal documents»: if the box «One step: approve the templates with the club's facts» is at the top, check the club's facts in it and press «Approve the missing texts now…»: each text not yet approved gets version 1, from its template, with the club's facts. A text already approved is not touched.

One text: on its card in «Legal documents» press «Regenerate from the template» and confirm. All at once: under «Every text at once» press «Regenerate from the templates», or on «New version» press «Regenerate all». One draft is made for each; nothing takes effect yet, and the list opens on «Drafts».
Open each draft (the «Drafts» filter shows them all), read it and fill in what is left written <…>, in Romanian and in English; «Save draft».
Back on «Legal documents»: «Approve the drafts» and confirm. The drafts ready to approve take effect together; what cannot be approved at once is written under the button, with the reason.
What is in force for each text: the card's head says «In force: version…» or «No version in force»; the filters «In force», «Replaced» and «Withdrawn» show the rest.

Without approved terms, notice and a race declaration nobody can register. For a road race the editor picks the road declaration once it is approved, the mountain event one until then. A group run offers its declaration only when it ticks it and its text (asphalt or trail) is approved.
Until you approve the new notice, the public participant list shows the confirmed only; after that, the waiting list appears only on events with «The waiting list is public» ticked.

The «BIB» column on the «Who's coming» list (the race number) appears once you approve the privacy notice from the new template. First write to those already registered: «Events» → «Open» → the «Registrations received» card → «Send a message to participants»; tell them their number will appear beside their name and that, if they do not want it, they press «I do not want to appear on the participants & results list» in «My registrations» (the number leaves with the name).

Then approve the notice: the «GDPR» card → «Regenerate from the template» → the draft → «Save draft» → «Approve and publish». From then on the column shows the number of every confirmed runner who has one, whichever notice they registered under; a confirmed runner without one shows “—”. «Tasks» → «Club» carries its row until then.

Drafts or versions you no longer need: tick them in the table, press «Delete the ticked versions» and check the list. Drafts only: «Delete the drafts» and confirm. With an approved version in the list: under «Confirmation» type the text asked for (for example “DELETE 2”), under «Reason» why, then «Delete the versions».

The signed declarations of a group run, when the signer asks for them to be erased: «Events» → «Edit» on the run → «Signed declarations (group run)» → «Erase several at once»: tick them, fill in «Why it is erased» once, press «Erase the ticked ones» and confirm. The log keeps your name and the reason, not the signer's.

tasks.title: How the declaration is signed
steps: The participant reads the text filled in with their name and the event, types their identity document's series and number (no ID picture is ever uploaded) and signs with a finger or the mouse.
A minor aged 14 to 17 signs beside the parent or guardian, each with their own identity document; nobody under 14 can register for any event.
Kept: the names, the documents, the text's version, its fingerprint, the moment and the method. It is a simple electronic signature.

Then they get the signed declaration by email, as a PDF, through the email queue (by «Deadlines» → «When emails leave»). At the desk, the kit is handed over against the document written in the declaration.
Whoever cannot sign online signs on paper at the desk, and the volunteer presses «Confirm on paper». The club keeps the signed original.
Every new signature keeps the SHA-256 fingerprint of the text signed. The PDF prints it with the version and the second of signing; the registration shows its first 12 characters.

tasks.title: Minors and the minimum age
steps: A participant under 18 is registered by a parent or guardian, who writes their name in the form's section for minors; the desk and the export show “Minor — parent/guardian”.

The minimum age is each event's own, of any type: «Minimum age to take part», under «Programme, rules and declaration» → «Rules». The event's page says it. It is counted on the day of the event, at every door — the form, the desk, a registration entered by staff. The run declaration is signed from 18, whatever the run's minimum age.

tasks.title: Where the data lives and how long it is kept
steps: Declarations are records in the database, not files; the PDF is made on request, identically.
Registrations and declarations are kept 3 years from the event, then deleted by themselves. The emergency contact and the health note are deleted 7 days after the event.
Downloaded exports and PDFs that carry identity documents are yours to delete, within 7 days of the event.
The privacy notice says exactly this.
A complaint or dispute in progress: on the registration or under «Signed declarations (group run)», «Keep: a complaint or dispute in progress». Nothing deletes it until «Remove the keep».

tasks.title: A GDPR request: access, withdrawal, erasure
steps: «Registrations» → find the person → open the registration.
What we hold about them: «Everything held about this person».
Withdraw a consent (the health note, the socials, the public results, the offers and benefits): «Withdraw consent» → tick what they withdraw → «Reason» → «Withdraw».
Erasure: «Delete permanently» (see “Correct, cancel or erase a registration”). The history keeps who erased and why, never the person's data.

sections.title: The participant — their steps, and how to test them
sections.who: No account. Everything by email. Walk them once on the test site (QA), with your own address.

tasks.title: Registering, from the form to the QR code
steps: On the event page press «Register for this event».
Fill in the form. For a race: «Read the race conditions», scroll to the end, then «I have read them and I agree». Tick the terms too.
Press «Submit registration». If something is missing, «Still missing:» appears above the button with each item — tap one and it takes you there.
In the email press «Confirm your email». The link is valid for {confirmation}.

Once confirmed, the page tells them the declaration comes by email. From the «Sign the declaration» email → tick «I have read and accept the declaration…» → «Sign». Without the tick, the page says right under the box what is missing.
They get the confirmation with the QR code and the race number, plus the signed declaration as a PDF.
Check in the backoffice: «Registrations» → search the name → the status «Confirmată» (confirmed).

tasks.title: Their place and deadlines
steps: Once the address is confirmed, the place is held for {hold} (or until the confirmation deadline, for an event further away than its window). The deadline matters only if somebody is waiting for a place; otherwise the place stays theirs until the start.

Event full, or somebody already waiting: they join the waiting list. When a place comes to them — by itself, or chosen by the club, as the event is set — they get the «A place has freed up» email and have {offer} to accept it and sign the declaration.
From {checkin} before the start, from «Manage your registration» they can press «I have arrived — mark me as here». They still pick up the number at the desk.

tasks.title: They withdraw or cannot come any more
steps: From any email about their registration: «I can't make it any more» → at «Why are you cancelling?» choose the reason (for «Another reason» they write it in short) → «Cancel the registration for…» (with the person's name) → «Yes, cancel».
On a family's email, the button opens «My registrations», with each person: «Withdraw from this registration», with the reason chosen too. The same any time, from the site, with their address.

In a family's declarations: «Withdraw the registration for…», with the reason chosen too. The place goes to the waiting list at once, or stays free for the club, if that event's places are not allocated automatically.
The reason shows on the registration's page, in the export and in the club's copy of the cancellation email.

tasks.title: No email arrived
steps: On the site, «Send the registration link again» → the address → «Send the link».
Or they come to the desk and a volunteer confirms them there, on paper.

tasks.title: Events in their calendar
steps: Every event has Google Calendar and the calendar file (.ics).
On the events page they can subscribe to the club's whole calendar; it updates by itself when you publish something new.

sections.title: A family on one address
sections.who: For every role. How several people register with the same email.

tasks.title: Register a second person on the same address
steps: The first person registers with the form, like anyone.

The form is sent again with the same address for a different person — another name and another birth date than every person already registered, or, on a registered person's birth date, another name and the other sex (a brother and a sister born on the same day). Nobody is registered yet: the screen shows the same “check your email” as always, so nobody learns from the form who is registered.

With «Yes, one more person» on the screen after the form, each next form reserves that person’s place at once. The address then gets one email for everybody, with one button. While anyone is on the waiting list nothing is reserved: the whole family joins the list once the address is confirmed.
The address gets the email “Registering one more person?”, with who is already registered and the person from the form, and one button, «I confirm I am registering another person».

The page it opens shows the details again; for an adult it asks one tick (the person declares their own health when they sign). The confirmation registers them straight away — no second confirmation link. The link is valid for {confirmation} and works once; unconfirmed details are deleted by themselves after that.

If only the name or only the birth date differs — or another name on a registered person's birth date, of the same sex — nobody is registered: the address gets the existing registration's email, with one sentence on how to register someone else.

One address may register at most {people} for an event. The form (under the address), the «Yes, one more person» screen (how many people were sent so far, out of the limit), «My registrations» and the terms all say the limit. At the limit, the email and the screen say so, and the email carries no button.

tasks.title: What follows for each person
steps: Each person signs their own declaration (their own email with the declaration) — an adult never signs for another adult; for a minor, the same rules as any registration. Each has their own place, their own race number and, if it comes to it, their own place on the waiting list.
The address receives one QR code for each confirmed person, in separate emails.
At the desk you scan each code in turn: each opens that person's own row.

tasks.title: What you see in the backoffice
steps: In «Registrations», at the desk and in the export, each person is a row of their own, with the same address.
The rows of one address at an event carry the «Family» label with the others’ names: in «Registrations», in the registration queue, at the desk and in the export’s last column, family.
«My registrations» lists every registration of the address, each with its name. Cancelling or erasing one leaves the others alone.
Reminders and thank-yous come one per person.

tasks.title: Change the limit per address (Administrator)
steps: «Settings» → «Deadlines» → «Registrations per address (per event)».
Type the number, press «Save the limit» and confirm.

sections.title: When something goes wrong
sections.who: For everyone. What to check, and who to write to.

tasks.title: Check whether the site is working
steps: Open /api/health?deep=1 in a new tab and read only the first word after "status", at the very start of the text: ok means the site is working, degraded or down means a problem, even if ok appears further down.
Not sure what you see? Send the text to the club's owner.

tasks.title: Write to someone when something is wrong
steps: A page shows an error, a button does nothing, or a press never finishes? Take a screenshot of what it says.
Write to the club's owner or a superadministrator: what you pressed, on what page, and the screenshot.
Do not wait for it to fix itself: an email that never sent or a stuck registration matters to someone waiting.

tasks.title: A save fails from an office laptop
steps: An office network sometimes blocks the request to the server, especially a company one.
Try again after turning on your phone's hotspot and connecting the laptop to it.
Works over the hotspot but not the office network? Tell someone at the office — it is the network's problem, not the site's.

guide.yours: Your role: {role}. Your sections come first and open; the rest are your colleagues'.
guide.familyPending: Not switched on on this environment yet: the database keeps one registration per address per event. Until then, sending the form for another person only re-sends the first registration's email.
guide.network: A save fails on an office laptop?

erase.title: Permanent deletion: {event}
erase.whatGoes: This permanently deletes the event “{event}” of {date}, in both languages, together with its {count} registrations and the personal data behind them.
erase.whatGoesUndated: This permanently deletes the event “{event}”, whose date is to be announced later, in both languages, together with its {count} registrations and the personal data behind them.
erase.realPeople: {count} of the registrations belong to real people. They go with their signed declarations and their addresses, and nothing can be recovered.
erase.noRealPeople: No real registration: nobody loses a place.
erase.alternative: If the event took place, archive it instead: it stays in the records and disappears from the site. Permanent deletion is for an event that should never have existed.
erase.typeTitleHelp: Type “{title}” exactly, to confirm. Anything else stops the deletion.
erase.reasonHelp: It is kept in the audit trail. It is the only thing that survives the deletion; the names of the people erased are kept nowhere.
erase.action: Permanently delete the event and its registrations

forms.kept: What you typed is still in the boxes; correct it and send again.
forms.keptConflict: What you typed is still in the boxes — copy what you need, then reload the page.
forms.keptExceptConfirmation: What you typed is still in the boxes, except the confirmation, which is asked again.

participantMessages.title: Send a message to participants
participantMessages.intro: An email you write, in Romanian and English, to the people registered for this event. Each receives it in the language they registered in.
participantMessages.audienceHelp: Cancelled or lapsed registrations and unconfirmed email addresses receive nothing. The number beside each group is the registrations as they are now.

audiences.ALL_ACTIVE: Everyone registered: confirmed, on the waiting list and those who have not signed the declaration yet
audiences.WAITLIST: Only the waiting list, and those offered a place
audiences.PENDING_DECLARATION: Only those registered who have not signed the declaration yet

participantMessages.nobody: Nobody is in the chosen group right now.
participantMessages.nobodyYet: Nobody is registered for this event right now, so there is nobody to receive the message.
participantMessages.noRegistrationHere: This event takes no registrations on the site, so there is nobody to message from here.
participantMessages.testLine: Test registrations, which receive it too and are counted nowhere: {test}.
participantMessages.cost: Emails, the club's copies included: {messages} — taken from the Mailgun allowance ({allowance}).
participantMessages.deferredDay: {now} of them can go today; the other {deferred} stay in the queue and go by themselves after midnight (UTC), when the daily allowance comes back. None is lost.
participantMessages.deferredMonth: {now} of them can go this month; the other {deferred} stay in the queue and go by themselves when the monthly allowance comes back. None is lost.
participantMessages.subject: Subject
participantMessages.subjectHelp: In both languages, required, at most {max} characters each. You can use the fields {list}; they are filled in for each participant.
participantMessages.bodyHelp: Required in both languages, plain text, at most {max} characters each. Fields filled in for each participant: {list}.
participantMessages.bodyScope: Write only about this event: weather, place, time, safety, a change. No advertising, offers or other events: those need each person's separate consent.
participantMessages.previewHelp: Exactly the email that goes out, for a sample participant, {name}, number {bibNumber}. It updates as you type.
participantMessages.previewUnavailable: The preview is not available right now. The message can still be sent.
participantMessages.previewUnknown: Unknown fields: {names}. The message cannot be sent with them — use only the fields listed under the boxes.
participantMessages.confirmBody: The email enters the email queue now and leaves by «Deadlines» → «When emails leave», to each in their own language. It cannot be withdrawn.

sent.one: Message queued for {count} participant. It leaves at once or on the next scheduled round, by «When emails leave» in «Deadlines».
sent.few: Message queued for {count} participants. It leaves at once or on the next scheduled round, by «When emails leave» in «Deadlines».
sent.other: Message queued for {count} participants. It leaves at once or on the next scheduled round, by «When emails leave» in «Deadlines».

participantMessages.duplicate: This message had already been sent, so nothing was queued a second time.
participantMessages.cancelledNote: The event is cancelled. The message still goes if you send it — to announce a new date, for instance.
participantMessages.seriesNote: This event is part of a series: the message goes only to those registered for this date. For another date, open it from the editor and send from there.
participantMessages.historyEmpty: No message sent from here for this event yet.

groupRunDeclarations.title: Signed declarations (group run)
groupRunDeclarations.help: Who signed the optional declaration, and when. The club keeps it while it is needed; when the signer asks for its withdrawal, erase it here, with the reason.
groupRunDeclarations.helpMore: A signature marked “series” covers every date of the run; a new version is signed again, and the old one stays. No identity document is asked for; the signer's address is in the PDF.
groupRunDeclarations.reasonHelp: It stays in the club's log, with your name. Do not write the person's name.
groupRunDeclarations.eraseBody: The declaration and the messages about it are deleted for good. The log keeps your name and the reason, never the signer's.
groupRunDeclarations.erased: The declaration was erased. The log keeps your name and the reason.
groupRunDeclarations.batchHelp: Tick the declarations to erase, write the reason once and press «Erase the ticked ones». Each stays in the log with your name and the reason, never the signer's.

batchEraseBody.one: Erase {count} signed declaration for “{run}”? It cannot be recovered.
batchEraseBody.few: Erase {count} signed declarations for “{run}”? They cannot be recovered.
batchEraseBody.other: Erase {count} signed declarations for “{run}”? They cannot be recovered.

groupRunDeclarations.batchChanged: The ticked declarations changed meanwhile, or one is kept for a complaint. Nothing was erased: reload the page and tick again.

batchErased.one: {count} signed declaration was erased. The log keeps your name and the reason.
batchErased.few: {count} signed declarations were erased. The log keeps your name and the reason.
batchErased.other: {count} signed declarations were erased. The log keeps your name and the reason.

newsletter.title: Numbers and sends
newsletter.intro: How many subscribed on the contact page and to which topics, what was sent and when. The list with the addresses is the «Subscribers» card.
newsletter.off: The contact page does not offer the subscription yet: the notice in force does not describe the newsletter. Approve a new notice in /admin/legal from the template.
newsletter.counts: Confirmed subscribers: {confirmed} · addresses not confirmed yet: {unconfirmed}
newsletter.allowanceNone: The email plan has no ceiling: the whole newsletter leaves now.
newsletter.allowanceDay: At most {count} newsletter emails can leave today: half the daily allowance stays for registrations. What does not fit leaves over the next days, by itself.
newsletter.allowanceMonth: At most {count} newsletter emails can leave this month: a fifth of the monthly allowance stays for registrations. What does not fit leaves after the reset, by itself.
newsletter.composeIntro: A message to the subscribers of one topic, in Romanian and in English: each receives it in their own language first, with the unsubscribe link.
newsletter.topicHelp: The subscribers of this topic receive it, and those who receive everything the club sends.
newsletter.bodyHelp: Write as in a document: headings, lists, links and pictures. At most {max} characters of text; pictures do not count. No fields in braces.
newsletter.confirmBody: Topic: {topic}. Each receives it in their own language first, with the unsubscribe link. Once sent it cannot be stopped.
newsletter.withdrawTitle: Remove an address at someone's request
newsletter.withdrawHelp: When someone writes to say they no longer want the news: type their address here. We find it and delete it, with anything still waiting to be sent to it.
newsletter.withdrawConfirmTitle: Remove the address from the newsletter?
newsletter.withdrawConfirmBody: The address is deleted from the news list, with the topics chosen. The person can subscribe again from the contact page.

sent.one: The newsletter was queued for {count} subscriber.
sent.few: The newsletter was queued for {count} subscribers.
sent.other: The newsletter was queued for {count} subscribers.

newsletter.duplicate: This newsletter had already been sent: nothing more was queued.
newsletter.withdrawn: The address was removed from the newsletter.
newsletter.notFound: The address was not on the newsletter.
newsletter.lastSendNone: Nothing sent to the subscribers yet.
newsletter.previewHelp: The message exactly as a subscriber receives it, from what the boxes hold now — with their unsubscribe link replaced by an example.
newsletter.previewUnavailable: The preview is not available right now. The message can still be sent.

subscribers.title: Subscribers
subscribers.intro: Every subscribed address, newest first. Search, filter, download the list or remove someone at their request.
subscribers.searchHelp: the whole address or part of it
subscribers.truncated: The first {count} addresses are shown. The CSV has them all.

link.sending: The confirmation email has not left yet.

subscribers.unsubscribeBody: The address leaves the newsletter, with its topics, as when the person unsubscribes. They can subscribe again from the contact page.

promo.title: Participants who ticked offers and benefits
promo.intro: Who ticked, when registering, that they want offers and benefits from the club and its partners. It is not the newsletter. Partners receive only the list for sponsors, below.
promo.truncated: The table shows the first {count}; «Download CSV» takes them all.
promo.empty: Nobody has ticked offers and benefits yet.

team.title: The «Team» page
team.intro: The club's people, one card each. A new card stays hidden until an Administrator puts it on the site; ask the person's consent for their name and photograph.
team.noneShown: No card is on the site, so the page does not appear in the site's menu.
team.readOnly: You can read the cards; the Copywriter or the Administrator writes them.
team.showIsAdmin: You write and prepare the cards; the Administrator puts them on the site.
team.noStorage: Picture storage is not configured here, so no photo can be added.
team.listLabel: The team's cards, in the page's order
team.showBody: The card appears on the team page while the page is published. Do you have the person's consent for the name and photograph?
team.hideBody: The card stays here, hidden; you can put it back at any time.
team.deleteBody: The card is gone for good. The photo stays in Pictures for a week and is then deleted on its own, if nothing uses it any more.
team.name: Name
team.nameHelp: As the person wants to appear: first and last name, or the first name only.
team.roleRo: What they do for the club (Română)
team.roleEn: What they do for the club (English)
team.bioHelp: Optional, in both languages or in neither, at most {max} characters each. As on a page: paragraphs, lists, a link in the text, a picture — no tables, the card is too narrow.
team.bothOrNeither: Write it in both languages or in neither.
team.photoFailed: The photo did not upload. Try again or choose another file (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
team.photoHelp: Once you choose the photo, you choose the part the card shows. With no crop, the card shows it square, keeping the face near the top. It is kept when you save the card.
team.photoCropHelp: It starts square (1:1), as a portrait. You can choose another shape or drag a box over the photo. The arrows move it; Shift with them resizes it.
team.pagePublishedHelp: The page is on the site in both languages: {ro} and {en}. It appears in the menu while it has at least one card on the site.
team.pageDraftHelp: The page is not on the site: its address answers "not found" and the menu does not show it. Prepare the cards, then publish the page.
team.noticeMissing: The notice in force does not yet describe the team page. First approve a new notice in /admin/legal, then publish the page.
team.publishBody: The page goes on the site in both languages at once, at {ro} and {en}, with every card that is on the site. Do you have the consent of every person on the cards?
team.unpublishBody: The page leaves the site in both languages and disappears from the menu. The cards stay here; you can publish it again at any time.
team.introHelp: Optional, in both languages or in neither, at most {max} characters each. As on a page: headings, lists, links, pictures, a film, a table. Empty, the page uses the default text.
team.linksHelp: At most {max}, each starting with https://. The label is optional, in both languages or neither; without one, the card shows the network's name.

faq.title: The «FAQ» page
faq.intro: The club's questions with their answers, in Romanian and English, grouped by category. The whole page saves with one button; a new question stays hidden until an Administrator shows it.
faq.noneShown: No question is on the site, so the page does not appear in the site's menu.
faq.readOnly: You can read the questions; the Copywriter or the Administrator writes them.
faq.showIsAdmin: You write and prepare the questions; the Administrator puts them on the site.
faq.listLabel: The questions, in the page's order
faq.introHelp: Optional, in both languages or in neither, at most {max} characters; without it the page opens with the sentence below. It may hold links, pictures and tables.
faq.questionsHelp: In the page's order. The arrows move a card and save the page; a new question is filled in on the last card.
faq.newHelp: Fill in the card to add a question; left empty, nothing is added.
faq.questionHelp: One line, the way a runner would ask it. Required in both languages.
faq.categoryHelp: Optional, in both languages or in neither: questions with the same category sit together on the page, under it.
faq.answerHelp: Required in both languages, at most {max} characters: paragraphs, lists, links and pictures — no tables.
faq.showBody: The page is saved, and the question and its answer appear on the FAQ page, in both languages, while the page is published.
faq.showConfirm: Save and put on the site
faq.hideBody: The page is saved, and the question stays here, hidden; you can put it back at any time.
faq.hideConfirm: Save and take off the site
faq.deleteBody: The page is saved, and the question and its answer are gone for good, in both languages.
faq.pagePublishedHelp: The page is on the site in both languages: {ro} and {en}. It appears in the menu while it has at least one question on the site.
faq.pageDraftHelp: The page is not on the site: its address answers "not found" and the menu does not show it. Prepare the questions, then publish the page.
faq.publishBody: The page goes on the site in both languages at once, at {ro} and {en}, with every question that is on the site.
faq.unpublishBody: The page leaves the site in both languages and disappears from the menu. The questions stay here; you can publish it again at any time.

members.title: Members
members.intro: The public «Members' benefits» page, with the sign-in button, and the members' area. A member is an account added on Staff with the role Membru: the site, never the backoffice.
members.readOnly: You can read these texts; the Copywriter and the Administrator write them.
members.publishIsAdmin: An Administrator puts the page on the site.
members.pagePublishedHelp: On the site at {ro} and {en}, with «Members' zone» in the site's footer. The members' area opens either way, after signing in.
members.pageDraftHelp: Not on the site: the address answers "page not found". The members' area works anyway, for whoever has an account.
members.unpublish: Take the page off the site
members.publishBody: The page appears in both languages, at {ro} and {en}, with «Members' zone» in the site's footer.
members.unpublishTitle: Take the page off the site?
members.unpublishBody: The address will answer "page not found" and «Members' zone» leaves the site's footer. The members' area stays open for whoever has an account.
members.benefitsHelp: On the public page, above the sign-in button: what a member of the club gets. Unwritten, the page shows a default sentence.
members.zoneHelp: What a member sees after signing in. It is on no public page. A picture in it has an address that is hard to guess, but not secret.
members.textHelp: In both languages or in neither, at most {max} characters each. As on a page: headings, lists, links, pictures, a table.

codes.heading: Discount codes
codes.help: The codes appear only in the members' area, after signing in. They are not on the site, in emails or in the newsletter.
codes.wordsOnly: You may write the partner and the description. An administrator changes the code, the link and the date.
codes.listLabel: The discount codes, in the members' area's order
codes.showBody: Members will see it in their area.
codes.hideBody: Members no longer see it. The code stays here and you can show it again at any time.
codes.deleteBody: The code is gone for good, for every member.
codes.saveBody: Members see the new text as soon as you save.
codes.partnerHelp: Who gives the discount, for example the shop's name.
codes.codeHelp: Exactly as the member types it at the partner's.
codes.descriptionHelp: What it gives and how to use it, in short.
codes.bothOrNeither: In both languages or in neither.
codes.linkHelp: Where the code is used, with https://.
codes.validUntilHelp: The last day members see it. Empty: no end.
codes.createBody: Members see it in their area as soon as you add it.

declarationHold.title: Keep for a complaint or a dispute
declarationHold.help: Use it only while a complaint, a dispute or proceedings are under way. While it is set, the declaration is not deleted.
declarationHold.releaseHelp: When the case is over, remove the keep. The declaration then goes back to its usual period.
declarationHold.reasonHelp: Say what it is about, without the person's name.
declarationHold.releaseReasonHelp: Say why it ends, without the person's name.
declarationHold.hold: Keep: a complaint or dispute in progress
declarationHold.holdBody: It is no longer deleted automatically, and nobody can delete it until you remove the keep.
declarationHold.releaseBody: The declaration goes back to its usual period and can be deleted again.

sponsors.noticeMissing: The privacy notice in force does not say the list may be given to partners.
sponsors.help: First name, last name, address, event, consent date: adults only, consent given under a notice that allows it. Write whom it goes to: it stays on each registration in it. Delete the file in 30 days.
sponsors.helpExcel: The Excel file also has every tick of each person, so you see what they agreed to. Give the partner the CSV.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: A place kept for a chosen person until a deadline: they get an email with a link to the form.
invitations.empty: No invitation sent for this event.
invitations.typedLabel: Other people: name and address, one per line
invitations.typedHelp: One person per line: the name, then the email address. Blank lines are skipped.
invitations.daysHelp: The place is kept this many days, at most until the start; from 1 to {max}.
invitations.outsideLabel: On the special guests list (takes no place)
invitations.outsideHelp: For organizers, volunteers, pacemakers and invited runners, who take none of the announced places: the invitation holds no place, and the registration will be a special guest's.
invitations.localeHelp: For typed addresses the club does not know yet. A member gets the invitation in the account's language, and somebody who has registered with the club before in the language they registered in.

dialog.title: Send the invitations?
dialog.free: Places free for invitations now: {free} — whoever waits on the list comes first.

raise.one: {count} supplementary place is added: the capacity becomes {capacity}.
raise.few: {count} supplementary places are added: the capacity becomes {capacity}.
raise.other: {count} supplementary places are added: the capacity becomes {capacity}.

dialog.noRaise: No new place: they fit in the free places.

days.one: The invitation expires in one day, at the latest at the start.
days.few: The invitation expires in {count} days, at the latest at the start.
days.other: The invitation expires in {count} days, at the latest at the start.

dialog.locale: Language for addresses the club does not know: {language}.
dialog.outside: On the special guests list: they hold no place.

invitations.resendBody: {name} gets the invitation again, with a new link; the old link stops working. The deadline moves to {days} days from now, if that is later than the current one.
invitations.resendBodyWaiting: {name} gets the invitation again with a new link; the old one stops working. The deadline stays: someone is waiting, and if the invitation is not accepted by then, the place goes to the waiting list.
invitations.resendBodyKept: {name} gets the invitation again, with a new link; the old link stops working. The deadline stays as it is; to move it later, type a number of days.
invitations.withdrawBody: The link {name} received registers nobody any more, and the kept place is released.

errors.INVITATION_ALREADY_REGISTERED: {name} is already registered for this event: no invitation was sent.
errors.INVITATION_ALREADY_INVITED: {name} already has an invitation waiting: no invitation was sent.
errors.INVITATION_BAD_ADDRESS: The address of {name} is not a valid email address: no invitation was sent.
errors.INVITATION_DUPLICATE: {name} appears twice in the list: no invitation was sent.
errors.INVITATION_NO_NAME: A line has no name: no invitation was sent.
errors.INVITATION_NOBODY: Tick at least one member or type a line.
errors.INVITATION_TOO_MANY: At most 50 people per press: split the list.
errors.INVITATION_EVENT_CLOSED: The event takes no more invitations: it is cancelled, has started, or is not published.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_OPEN: The invitation is no longer waiting: it was accepted, withdrawn or has expired.
errors.INVITATION_BAD_DAYS: Days until it expires: a whole number from 1 to 60.
errors.INVITATION_UNREAD_LINE: Lines {lines} are not a name and an address: no invitation was sent.
errors.SUPPLEMENTARY_PLACE_UNCONFIRMED: Nothing was sent: the places changed since you opened the page. Press again: the question now says how many places are added.
errors.generic: Nothing was sent: check the list and try again.

Legal.unavailable: This document has not been published for this environment yet.
Legal.botCheckNotice: The “not a robot” check is done by Cloudflare (it sees the IP and technical browser data).

Registration.title: Register: {event}
Registration.listOptIn: I want to appear on the participants & results list
Registration.listSocials: Also show my Strava and Instagram beside my name on the list
Registration.listSocialsHelp: Only with the tick above. Take them off any time from “My registrations”.
Registration.incompleteHint: Fill in the fields marked with * to send.
Registration.submittedAlready: If you were already registered, the email shows your existing registration: no second one is created.

done.heading: Almost there!
done.lead: We have emailed you a link to confirm your place at {event}, {date}.

open.title: Open the email and press the link

declare.title: Sign the declaration
declare.body: From that same email: read it and type your name — online, or on paper at the registration desk on race day.
declare.bodyLater: The place is yours. We ask for the declaration {opens} before the start, online or on paper at the registration desk; you can sign earlier too.

confirmed.title: You are in
confirmed.body: You get the confirmation, with your QR code and race number. See you at the start!

done.familyEach: Each person gets their own email.

deliveryNotice.capture: This is a development environment: no email is sent from here at all — messages can only be read in the backoffice. Do not wait for one in your inbox.
deliveryNotice.allowlist: This is the test environment: emails reach only the addresses the club has authorized. If yours is not among them, nothing will arrive — and that is not your fault.
deliveryNotice.everyone: This is the test site: emails really are sent from here, marked “[QA]” in the subject — but a registration made here is not a real one and holds no place in the race.

errors.title: The registration could not be submitted
errors.phone: The number is not valid. Type only the digits of the number, without the country code (that is chosen on the left).
errors.emergencySame: The emergency contact needs a different number from yours — nobody can ring your own phone if something happens to you.
errors.tooYoung: The minimum age for this event is {age} on the day of the race.
errors.captcha: The anti-bot check did not pass. Tick the box again and resend.
errors.generic: The registration could not be submitted. Check what you entered and try again.
errors.throttledTitle: You have already sent this form a few times
errors.databaseAwayTitle: We could not reach our records just now
errors.databaseAway: Nothing was registered and no email is on its way. Everything you filled in is still below — try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, the site may be paused for a while; the event page says until when.
errors.throttled: We have had several registrations from this address in the last hour, so we have paused it for a while. Try again in an hour — or, if it is urgent, write to us through the contact form and we will register you ourselves. Nothing you filled in has been lost.
errors.tooFast: The automated check did not pass first time — it happens to real people too. Your answers are still here.
errors.tooFastNothingSent: Nothing was registered and no email was sent to you. Press “Send the registration again” — your answers and your ticks are still here.
errors.waitlistFullNothingSent: Nothing was registered and no email was sent. What you filled in is still in the form.
errors.sittingAtCap: The people already sent with this address reach the club's limit: one email address may register at most {people} for an event. Nothing was registered for this person: press “Done” or use another address.

Registration.displayNameHelp: By default the list and the results show your full name; if you would rather show something else, such as “Ana P.”, write it here.
Registration.birthDateUnreadable: Type the date as day, month, year: 11.05.1990.

ageRule.minimumAndGuardian: Minimum age: {age}. Under 18, a parent or legal guardian registers the runner, with their consent.
ageRule.minimumAndConsent: Minimum age: {age}. Under 18, a parent's consent is needed to take part.

Registration.preferredLocale: The language for your emails and the declaration
Registration.preferredLocaleHelp: Emails come in both languages, this one first.

countrySearch.search: Search for a country (name, code or prefix)

Registration.phoneHelp: Without the country code, for example 0712 345 678.
Registration.emergencyContactHelp: Tell this person you gave us their number: we call only if something happens to you at the race. We delete the name and number seven days after the event.
Registration.healthConsent: I agree that the race organizers may keep this health information, only for my safety on race day. I can withdraw it at any time from “My registrations”.
Registration.displayNameToggle: Want to appear publicly under a different name?

fieldNames.fitnessDeclared: The statement that you are medically fit
fieldNames.emailConfirm: The address typed a second time
fieldNames.fitnessAcknowledged: The acknowledgement about the person's fitness statement

resend.title: Send the registration link again
