resend.intro: If our message did not arrive, enter the address you registered with and we will send the link again. Check your spam folder too.
resend.emailHelp: The address you used when registering.
resend.sent: If that address has a registration, we have just sent the link there.
resend.sentScheduled: If there is a registration on this address, the link leaves for it on the platform's next scheduled round, within {wait} at the most.
resend.stillNothing: Nothing arrived even after asking again?
resend.contactLinkLabel: Write to us and we will register you

form.title: Fill in the form
form.body: Your name, email, phone and an emergency contact. It takes a minute.

email.title: Confirm your email address
email.body: You get a link. Open it within {confirmation} — otherwise the registration expires and the place stays free.

declaration.title: Sign the declaration
declaration.body: From that same email, sign it online or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held for {hold}; if there is a waiting list, it then goes to the next in line.
declaration.bodyLater: The race is free, so we ask for a confirmation: {opens} before the start you get an email and sign the declaration, online or on paper at the registration desk. You can sign earlier too. If there is a waiting list, the place is held until {due}.
declaration.bodyLaterAtStart: The race is free, so we ask for a confirmation: sign the declaration from the registration email any time before the start, online or on paper at the registration desk. We remind you {opens} before. The place does not lapse before the start.

confirmed.title: You are in
confirmed.body: You get the confirmation email, with your QR code and race number. We send a reminder {reminder} before the start.
confirmed.bodyNoReminder: You get the confirmation email, with your QR code and race number.

raceDay.title: On race day
raceDay.body: Show the QR code (or say your name) at the registration desk and collect your number.

waitingList.title: If it is full
waitingList.body: You join the waiting list, in order of registration. When a place frees up, you get an offer by email and {offer} to sign the declaration.

family.title: Registering someone else on the same address?
family.body: Send the form again with the person's full name and birth date — you get an email where you confirm with one button.

refusal.title: The club may refuse a registration
refusal.body: Only on an objective ground in the terms (conditions not met, false or incomplete details, capacity, safety, conduct, a breach of the terms), told by email — never on a ground the law forbids.

now.details: We will then email you to confirm your address.
now.confirm: We have sent you a confirmation link.

declare.emailJustSent: One step left: read and sign the declaration from the email we have just sent you — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — usually within a few minutes, within the hour at the latest.
declare.emailHeldUntil: Your place is held. We ask for the declaration by email {opens} before the start — you sign it then, online or on paper at the registration desk; once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — usually within a few minutes, within the hour at the latest.
declare.onThisPage: One step left: read and sign the declaration below — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — usually within a few minutes, within the hour at the latest.
declare.emailReceived: One step left: read and sign the declaration from the email you received — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — usually within a few minutes, within the hour at the latest.

declareScheduled.emailJustSent: One step left: read and sign the declaration from the email on its way to you — it leaves within {wait} at the most — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number.
declareScheduled.emailHeldUntil: Your place is held. We ask for the declaration by email {opens} before the start — you sign it then, online or on paper at the registration desk; once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — it leaves on the platform's scheduled round, within {wait} at the most.
declareScheduled.onThisPage: One step left: read and sign the declaration below — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — it leaves on the platform's scheduled round, within {wait} at the most.
declareScheduled.emailReceived: One step left: read and sign the declaration from the email you received — or on paper at the registration desk on race day. Your place is held. Once you sign, we email you the signed declaration (PDF) and your race number — it leaves on the platform's scheduled round, within {wait} at the most.

now.done: Your registration is confirmed. See you at the start!

disclosure.guardian: Registering a minor — parent or legal guardian

Registration.clubMemberDeclared: I am a member of the {club} group
Registration.clubNameFromMembership: Filled in from the member tick. Untick it to enter another club.
Registration.socialsHelp: Used only to follow and tag you in the club's posts; a tag is public on that network. Never shown on the site. Delete them any time from “My registrations”.
Registration.socialsHelpList: Used to follow and tag you in the club's posts; a tag is public on that network. On the site they show only with the tick further down. Delete them any time from “My registrations”.
Registration.stravaUrlHelp: From the Strava app: Profile → Share → copy the link.
Registration.guardianHelp: Required under 18. You, the parent or guardian, sign the declaration, collect the kit and give the choices below for the child; the email and phone may be yours.
Registration.guardianName: Full name of the parent / guardian
Registration.guardianNameHelp: Required under 18. This name appears on the declaration as the signer.
Registration.privacyBanner: Nothing you write here appears on the site. We use it only to run the race: the organizing team and the providers that host the site and send the emails see it. The signed declaration is emailed to you, and a copy, with your identity document masked, goes to the club's archive. We keep the registration for three years after the event.

We use your details only to run the race: the organizing team and the providers that host the site and send the emails see them. The signed declaration is emailed to you, and a copy, with your identity document masked, goes to the club's archive. We keep the registration for three years after the event.

terms.acceptWithRefusal: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms and conditions</terms> (version {version}), including, expressly, the clauses on the club cancelling or changing an event, the club refusing or cancelling a registration, being stopped or excluded on the course, the limits of the club's liability, the governing law and the competent court.
terms.missing: We cannot take registrations just now: the club has no approved terms and conditions yet. Please come back soon.
terms.changed: The terms and conditions changed while you were filling in the form. Read the version named below and tick the box again.

Registration.botCheckExpired: The check expired — it is being redone; we send the form ourselves as soon as it answers; no need to press again.

invitation.addressAtCap: This address already has the most registrations allowed for the event: nothing was registered.
invitation.notYou: Not expecting this invitation? Ignore it or write to us:

cancelReason.label: Why are you cancelling?

confirm.title: Confirm your email address
confirm.prompt: We are confirming your email address. If nothing happens in a few seconds, press the button.
confirm.done: Your email address has been confirmed.
confirm.doneWaitlist: You are on the waiting list. If a place frees up, we email you what to do next.

declare.title: Event declaration
declare.accept: I have read and accept the declaration above, including, expressly, the limitation of the organiser's liability to the extent the law allows.

family.intro: Several people are registered on this address. Each signs here in turn, with their own name and document. The confirmation, with the QR codes, numbers and PDFs, comes by email.
family.lastSigned: The declaration for {name} is signed. The confirmation, with the QR code and the PDF of the declaration, is on its way by email.
family.lastWaitlisted: The place for {name} was no longer free: {name} is now on the waiting list.

what.closed: No longer waiting for a signature.

family.withdrawHelp: The place is released, and the address gets a confirmation email.

family.withdrawBodyNoEvent: The registration for {name} is cancelled and the place is released. It cannot be undone: to register again, send the form again.

declare.signPersonally: {participant} must sign this declaration personally. If this email address is not theirs, forward them the link or hand them the phone: nobody signs for another adult.
declare.typedName: Type your full name as a signature
declare.changed: The declaration was updated while you were reading it. Nothing was recorded. Below is the current text — please read it and sign again.
declare.waitlistFull: The deadline to sign had passed and your place goes to somebody on the waiting list. We could not put you back on the list, because it is full too, so the signature was not recorded.
declare.noWaitlist: The deadline to sign had passed and your place goes to somebody who was waiting for it. The event has no waiting list and no free places left, so the signature was not recorded.
declare.doneWaitlisted: The place was no longer available; you have been added to the waiting list.
declare.deadline: Your place is held until {deadline}. With no waiting list it stays yours after that, until the start — but the registration is complete only with the signed declaration.
declare.deadlineAtStart: Your place is held until the start, {deadline}: it does not lapse before. The registration is complete only with the signed declaration.
declare.deadlinePassed: The deadline, {deadline}, has passed, but the place is still yours: sign now and the registration is complete.
declare.idDocumentHelp: Your identity card (e.g. “BV 123456”) or passport; the kit is collected against it. Deleted seven days after the event, masked in the club's copy; we keep no copy of the document.
declare.typedNameHelp: Type the full name you registered with. It appears as a signature.
nextConfirmed: The confirmation email is on its way, with your QR code and your access code — keep it for race day.
You get a reminder {reminder} before the start, with the time, the place, what to bring and, if assigned, your race number.
If you can no longer come, cancel from the link in the email: your place goes to somebody on the waiting list.
nextWaitlisted: You are on the waiting list; if a place frees up, you get an email with a confirmation link.
The link has a deadline; if you do not confirm in time, the place moves on.
You can withdraw at any time from the email you received.
declare.pressFailed: We could not record the signature. Try again — your link is fine.
declare.acceptSummary: Tick the box “I have read and accept the declaration…” so you can sign.
declare.acceptInline: Tick this box so you can sign.
declare.idDocumentTypeHelp: Choose the kind of document — it appears in the declaration with the series and number.
declare.typedNameHelpWithName: You registered as {name} — type exactly this name. It appears as a signature.
declare.typedNameHelpForMinor: A parent or legal guardian of the minor {participant} signs, with the name given at registration: {name} — type exactly this name. It appears as a signature.
declare.signatureMismatch: The signature must be exactly the name you registered with: {name}.
declare.signatureMismatchForMinor: The signature must be exactly the parent or guardian name given at registration: {name}.
declare.signatureMismatchRich: The signature must be exactly the name you registered with: {name}.
declare.signatureMismatchForMinorRich: The signature must be exactly the parent or guardian name given at registration: {name}.
declare.signatureNameWrong: If the name given at registration is wrong, <contact>write to us</contact>: the club corrects it, and you then sign from the same link.
declare.signatureNameWrongReply: If the name given at registration is wrong, reply to the email you received or <contact>write to us</contact>: the club corrects it, and you then sign from the same link.
declare.signatureNameWrongForMinor: If the parent or guardian name given at registration is wrong, it cannot be changed on this registration: cancel it from <mine>My registrations</mine> (or <contact>write to us</contact> and the club cancels it), then register the minor again with the right name. The new registration gets a place like any other, or a place on the waiting list if the race has filled up by then.
declare.signatureNameWrongForMinorReply: If the parent or guardian name given at registration is wrong, it cannot be changed on this registration: cancel it from <mine>My registrations</mine> (or reply to the email you received, or <contact>write to us</contact>, and the club cancels it), then register the minor again with the right name. The new registration gets a place like any other, or a place on the waiting list if the race has filled up by then.
declare.nameRefusedTitle: The signature does not match the name given at registration
declare.nameRefusedNothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded and your link is fine: correct the name and sign again.
declare.documentRefusedTitle: An identity document is missing or not written correctly
declare.documentRefusedNothingRecorded: Nothing was recorded and your link is fine: type the document's series and number, for example “BV 123456”, and sign again.

declare.minorIdDocumentType: Which document the minor will show
declare.minorIdDocument: The minor's identity document (series and number)
declare.minorIdDocumentHelp: The minor's identity card — for example “BV 123456” — or passport. It goes into the declaration, beside the parent's or guardian's.
declare.guardianIdDocumentType: Which document the parent or guardian will show
declare.guardianIdDocument: The parent's or guardian's identity document (series and number)
declare.minorTypedNameHelp: The minor signs too, with the name they were registered under: {name} — type exactly this name. It appears as a signature.
declare.minorSignatureMismatch: The minor's signature must be exactly the name they were registered under: {name}.
declare.minorSignatureMismatchRich: The minor's signature must be exactly the name they were registered under: {name}.
declare.minorNameWrong: If the minor's name given at registration is wrong, <contact>write to us</contact>: the club corrects it, and you then sign from the same link.
declare.minorNameWrongReply: If the minor's name given at registration is wrong, reply to the email you received or <contact>write to us</contact>: the club corrects it, and you then sign from the same link.

CONFIRM_EMAIL.body: This link has already been used, but your registration is still waiting for your email address to be confirmed.

WAITLISTED.title: You are on the waiting list
WAITLISTED.body: This link has already been used. Your registration is in the event's waiting list.

CONFIRMED.title: Your registration is confirmed
CONFIRMED.body: This link has already been used and opens nothing more — but it does not need to: you have a place in the race. Your check-in code and QR code are in the confirmation email.

CANCELLED.title: This registration was cancelled
CANCELLED.body: This link was used to cancel. The place was released and the registration is no longer active.

LAPSED.title: This registration is no longer active
LAPSED.body: This link has already been used, and the registration has lapsed since — either the deadline passed or the event started.

family.title: Registering one more person
family.intro: The registration form for {event} was sent again from the address {email}, for another person. We have not registered them yet: check the details below and confirm.
family.next: Once confirmed, the person has their own place and receives at {email} their own email with the declaration to sign, then their own QR code. One address may register at most {people} for an event.
family.consent: Register someone only with their agreement, and tell them that their details come to us and how we use them: see the privacy notice. The messages about their registration come to this address.
family.adultNote: For an adult we keep none of the health information, the public-list choice or the Strava and Instagram from the form: these need the person's own consent.
family.fitnessAcknowledged: I know that the person I am registering declares themselves, when they sign their declaration, that their health allows the effort.
family.action: I confirm I am registering another person
family.wrongData: Are the details wrong? Do not confirm: send the form again with the correct full name and birth date. This link expires by itself, and the details sent are deleted.
family.done: Done. The email with the declaration to sign for this person comes to your address: each person signs their own declaration and gets their own QR code.
family.doneWaitlist: The person is on the waiting list. When a place frees up, an email comes to your address.
family.alreadyOnAddress: We did not register them: a person with the same name or the same birth date is already registered with this address. For someone else, send the form again with that person's full name and birth date.
family.atCap: We did not register them: one email address may register at most {people} for an event, and this address already has. For one more person, use their own email address. This link still works if a place on the address frees up.
family.fitnessMissing: First tick that the person declares their own health when they sign.
family.refused: We could not register the person with the details sent (the terms may have changed in the meantime, or the age is not allowed, for instance). Send the registration form again; this link was not used.
family.decline: I am not registering this person
family.declineIntro: The form for {event} was sent again from {email}, for the person below. If you do not want to register them, press the button: their details are deleted now.
family.declineBack: I want to register them after all
family.declined: Done — we registered nobody; the details sent have been deleted.

familySitting.title: Family registration for {event}
familySitting.intro: The form was sent from {email} for {people}. The places are reserved, but nobody is confirmed yet: check the list and press the button once.
familySitting.introLapsed: The form was sent from {email} for {people}. The places are no longer reserved: confirm anyway, and each person gets a place if one is still free, or else one on the waiting list.
familySitting.untick: Someone should not be registered? Untick them: their details are deleted when you press, and they are not registered. Wrong details? Untick the person and send the form again for them.
familySitting.withdrawLater: Someone should not be registered? Once confirmed, withdraw them from “All my registrations” and their place is freed.
familySitting.next: Once you press, the address {email} is confirmed, each person gets their own place (or a place on the waiting list), and you sign the declarations right away, one after the other. Each then gets their own QR code. At most {people} can register with one address for an event.
familySitting.fitnessAcknowledged: I know that the adults I am registering declare for themselves, when they sign their declaration, that their health allows the effort.
familySitting.done: The address is confirmed and the registrations are made.
familySitting.refusedAtCap: Someone on the list was not registered: the address has reached the most people allowed for this event.
familySitting.refusedAlready: Someone on the list was already registered with this address, so we did not register them twice.
familySitting.refusedWaitlist: Someone on the list did not fit: the places and the waiting list are full.
familySitting.refusedOther: Someone on the list could not be registered with the details sent (for example, the terms changed in the meantime). Send the form again for that person.
familySitting.nothingToSign: Nobody has a declaration to sign yet: those on the waiting list get an email when a place is offered to them.
familySitting.nobody: We registered nobody; the details sent have been deleted.
familySitting.nobodyRefused: We registered nobody on the list.

promo.closedYes: You ticked offers and benefits on this registration. While it is closed the club sends you nothing for it; you can withdraw your consent at any time.
promo.yes: On this registration you receive offers and benefits. Only the club sends them, to this registration's address; the partners never get your address.
promo.no: You did not tick offers and benefits on this registration.
promo.optIn: I want offers and benefits for this registration

overall.limited: Working, but doing less than you probably expect. See the marked items below.
overall.blocked: Something this deployment needs in order to start, or to work, is missing. See the red items below.

emailCaptureLocal.title: Email
emailCaptureLocal.body: Messages are kept in memory and go nowhere. The only mode local and test accept.

emailCaptureDeployed.title: Email
emailCaptureDeployed.body: Messages stay in memory and go nowhere, so nobody registering here gets the confirmation. For real delivery: EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE=allowlist, with EMAIL_ALLOWLIST and the three Mailgun variables.

emailAllowlist.title: Email
emailAllowlist.body: Transmits only to the addresses in EMAIL_ALLOWLIST; everything else is captured. Each address must also be an authorized recipient in Mailgun, spelled exactly the same.

emailLive.title: Email
emailLive.body: Transmits to anybody. Permitted in production only.

staffProvider.title: Staff sign-in
staffProvider.body: Through the identity provider. Who may in is still decided by the staff_users table, not by the provider.

staffDevSwitcher.title: Staff sign-in
staffDevSwitcher.body: Development identities, local and test only. Not real people.

staffDisabled.title: Staff sign-in
staffDisabled.body: There is no way in at all: every staff route answers 404. Correct for an environment with no provider configured.

jobs.title: Scheduled jobs
jobs.body: The only thing that drains the email queue and expires holds. Without JOB_SECRET the endpoints refuse every caller, and the symptom is not an error — it is email that never arrives.

webhook.title: Mailgun webhook
webhook.body: How a bounce reaches the registration it belongs to. Without the signing key, requests are refused and delivery state stays unknown.

contactFormCapture.title: Contact form
contactFormCapture.body: Messages are kept in memory and go nowhere — the only mode locally and in tests; no SMTP connection is ever opened.

contactFormSmtp.title: Contact form
contactFormSmtp.body: Sends over SMTP from the club's Gmail, not through Mailgun. Recipients come from Pages → Contact, else from CONTACT_FORM_TO; the label beside this says which.

contactFormNoRecipients.title: Contact form
contactFormNoRecipients.body: It can send, but to nobody: neither Pages → Contact nor CONTACT_FORM_TO holds an address. Until a recipient is set on Pages → Contact, “Write to us” shows the club's address.

contactFormOff.title: Contact form
contactFormOff.body: “Write to us” shows the club's address instead of the form: CONTACT_SMTP_USER (the Gmail address) and CONTACT_SMTP_PASSWORD (the app password) are missing. Recipients are set on Pages → Contact.

emailHealth.ok: Sending works: nothing deferred, overdue or failed. /api/health?deep=1 answers 200.
emailHealth.stalled: Sending has stopped — deferred (daily allowance): {deferred}; overdue: {overdue}; failed in 7 days: {failed}. Reason: “{reason}”. /api/health?deep=1 answers 503 until this clears.

APP_ENV.what: Which deployment this is. It, not NODE_ENV, decides whether live email may go out, whether the development sign-in switcher is allowed, and whether sample legal text and test registrations may exist.

values.local: A developer's own machine. Email is captured and never transmitted; the sign-in switcher is available; sample legal text is seeded.
values.test: The automated suites. Same guarantees as local, and nothing here ever reaches a person.
values.qa: The shared deployment colleagues try things on. Real database, real sign-in, and email either captured or restricted to an allowlist — never open delivery.
values.production: The club's real site. The only environment permitted to send live email, and the only one that refuses sample legal text and test registrations outright.

EMAIL_DELIVERY_MODE.what: How far a message actually goes once the outbox renders it. This is the guard between a test system and a stranger's inbox, and startup refuses any combination that would cross it.

values.capture: Nothing is transmitted. Messages are held in memory — which on a deployed serverless host means they reach nobody at all, so registration looks broken to anyone but a developer.
values.allowlist: Real delivery, but only to the addresses in EMAIL_ALLOWLIST; everything else is captured. This is what a Mailgun sandbox domain is, and it is how a small closed group tests the whole journey safely.
values.live: Real delivery to whoever registered. Permitted only when APP_ENV is production; stating it anywhere else fails at startup.

STAFF_AUTH_MODE.what: How staff prove who they are. Participants never sign in; the staff_users table decides who may enter, whatever the mode.

values.dev-switcher: A local shortcut that lets a developer become any role without an identity provider. Permitted only when APP_ENV is local or test; stating it elsewhere fails at startup.
values.provider: The real thing: Auth.js with Zitadel. The provider proves the address, and the staff_users allowlist decides whether that address may in.
values.disabled: No way in: every staff route answers 404, so the backoffice is unreachable, not merely hidden. Right for an environment with no identity provider.

Devs.operationalTitle: What each limit does when it is met
Devs.operationalIntro: Who stops you — the provider or this application's code — what the application does then, and which variable or monitor is involved. Costs live on Settings → Costs.

mailgunDaily.title: Mailgun's daily allowance (100 messages on the free plan)
mailgunDaily.body: Mailgun refuses with an HTTP 400; the application recognises the cap and keeps the message PENDING until just after midnight UTC instead of marking it FAILED. The signal is the volume figure above.

captureOnServerless.title: Capture mode delivers nothing on a deployed environment
captureOnServerless.body: On serverless, messages held in memory vanish with the process, so anyone not on the allowlist registers and hears nothing. Only allowlist with a real provider completes a registration.

schedulerFloor.title: The cadence of the scheduled jobs
schedulerFloor.body: Vercel Hobby runs once a day, so the jobs start from GitHub Actions and an external pinger, with JOB_SECRET. A late run delays a message but never overbooks an event.

hobbyCapPause.title: Exceeding a Hobby cap pauses the feature for 30 days
hobbyCapPause.body: Not a bill but a pause with a fixed end, which you cannot buy your way out of during the window. The only response is to upgrade beforehand. Only the Vercel dashboard shows it.

identityDomain.title: Zitadel Free: zero custom domains, one administrator
identityDomain.body: It decides which host staff sign in on. On the provider's hostname the limit is not felt; on the club's own domain it needs a paid tier. With no tenant, use STAFF_AUTH_MODE=disabled.

statementTimeout.title: statement_timeout 10s and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 30s
statementTimeout.body: Set by this application on the pool, not by Neon: no unbounded query can hold a Vercel function for 300 seconds. The connection has no timeout, so the database has time to wake.

Budget.intro: How much of the monthly limit the database has used, at what pace, and how the site slows itself down when the month runs ahead.

level.amber: Amber — the month is running ahead

meaning.unknown: Neon could not be read just now, so the site runs normally, with no extra brake.

meaning.red: More than {red}% of the limit is used: the site slows down as far as it can, and /api/health?deep=1 raises the alarm so the limit can be raised in time.

effect.none: nothing extra — the scheduled jobs run when they have something to do.
effect.floor: the scheduled jobs look at the database at most once every {minutes} minutes.
effect.cache: The public pages keep their data {factor} times longer; a change the club makes still shows at once.
effect.healthReuse: The health check reuses an answer at most {minutes} minutes old, so a stray caller does not wake the database.
effect.monitor: Emails leave as before (by «Deadlines» → «When emails leave»); registration and the backoffice work as usual.
effect.cacheOnly: Visitors no longer wake the database: a page that is not in the cache is shown from its last saved copy.
effect.floorMore: Reminders and freed places may wait that long; no place is ever given twice.
effect.cacheOnlyMore: The copy is refreshed in the background at most once every {minutes} minutes.

thresholds.intro: The thresholds, as percents of the monthly limit: amber from the first, red from the second (red raises the alarm on /api/health?deep=1).
thresholds.confirmBody: The site brakes by the new thresholds from the budget's next reading, within a minute.

Network.fallback: The network blocked the save, so we tried the simple way. It arrived only if you see the confirmation message; otherwise check the page and try from your phone.

blocked.title: The network blocked the save
blocked.kept: The network stopped the save, so we cannot tell whether it arrived. What you typed is still here. You can send it the simple way, which office networks let through.
blocked.notKept: The network stopped the save, so we cannot tell whether it arrived. You can send it again the simple way, with what the form held when you pressed.
blocked.already: The save may have arrived. Before you press, check the page in a new tab: if the change is there, do not press — a cancellation or a message would happen twice.
blocked.failed: The simple way could not leave either. Check the page before you try from your phone or another network.

page.title: Network check
page.intro: Some company networks stop the saves, the pictures or the bot check. This page tries each and says what the IT team has to allow.

saves.title: Saves
saves.meaning: The backoffice's save buttons send a POST request to the site with the Next-Action header; the answer's type is text/x-component.
saves.allow: Allow: POST requests to {host} with the Next-Action header, and their text/x-component answers.

post.title: The simple path
post.meaning: An ordinary form sent to the site — the way a save goes when the network blocks the first one. If only this one is green, saves still get through.
post.allow: Allow: forms sent by POST (multipart/form-data) to {host}.

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.meaning: The pictures in the gallery and in the texts load from the storage's address, not from the site.
pictures.none: No picture is stored yet to check with.
pictures.unconfigured: Picture storage is not configured here; there is nothing to check.

botCheck.title: The bot check
botCheck.meaning: The registration and contact forms load Cloudflare Turnstile's check.
botCheck.unconfigured: The bot check is not switched on for this site; there is nothing to allow.

report.title: The report for the club
report.intro: Copy the report and send it to the club or to the IT team. It holds only the results, the site's address and the browser's description — nothing about you.
report.copied: The report is copied; paste it into a message.
report.copyFailed: It could not be copied; select the text below and copy it.

topicHints.ALL: Every topic below, and any we add later.

topicHints.GEAR_TESTING: When a shop or a maker brings shoes and gear to try.
topicHints.SPECIAL_EVENTS: Special editions, themed runs, events held with other organizers and other organizers' events.

Newsletter.heading: The club's news by email
Newsletter.intro: Pick the topics you care about and we write to you about those alone.
Newsletter.dialogIntro: Tick what interests you. We email you a confirmation link; until you press it, you receive nothing else.
Newsletter.privacy: We keep your address and the topics you chose only to send you these emails; you unsubscribe at any time from the link in every message. Details in the
Newsletter.consent: I have read the privacy notice and agree to receive the club's news by email on the topics I ticked.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If the address is right, within a few minutes you receive an email with a link. The subscription starts only once you press it.
sent.bodyScheduled: If the address is right, you get an email with a link within {wait} at the most. The subscription starts only once you press the link.

errors.title: The subscription has not started yet
errors.consent: Tick the consent: without it we cannot send you the news.
errors.captcha: The anti-robot check did not pass. Tick it again and send.
errors.limited: You have already asked a few times in the last hour. Check your inbox (and the Spam folder) or try again later.
errors.unavailable: Subscribing to the news is not available right now. Try again later.

leave.intro: Type the address you receive the news at. We send it the link where you unsubscribe.
leave.sent: If the address is subscribed, you have received an email with the link to manage it.

Newsletter.linkInvalid: This link is no longer valid

confirm.title: Confirm your subscription
confirm.intro: Press the button to start receiving the club's news at {email}.
confirm.doneBody: We write to you only about the topics you chose. From the link in every email you change them or unsubscribe.
confirm.invalidBody: It may have been used already, expired, or you have asked for another since. To get a new one, subscribe again from the contact page.

manage.title: Your subscription to the news
manage.intro: You receive the club's news at {email}.
manage.saved: We saved what you want to receive.
manage.topicsRefused: Choose at least one topic — or, if you want nothing more, unsubscribe below.
manage.unsubscribeBody: We take you off the list and delete your address. You receive no more news emails; your event registrations are not touched.
manage.goneBody: We deleted your address from the news list. You can come back at any time from the contact page.
manage.invalidBody: It has expired or the subscription no longer exists. Every new email from us carries a new link; you can also subscribe again from the contact page.

Translate.all: Copy and translate everything: RO → EN
Translate.allHelp: Every text written in Romanian is translated automatically (DeepL) into its English box, with the same layout. Read, correct, then press Save.
Translate.off: Automatic translation is not on yet: the server has no DeepL key. It is set once, and then the button works in every editor.
Translate.offAskAdmin: Automatic translation is not on yet: the server has no DeepL key. Ask an Administrator to set it; the steps are under Tasks → Club.
Translate.spentAskAdmin: The DeepL credit is spent: automatic translation is off until an Administrator sets a new credit or key (Settings → Costs).
Translate.done: Translated. Read it, correct it if needed, then save.
Translate.doneAll: Boxes translated: {count}. Read them, correct them if needed, then save.
Translate.cut: Cut to the box's limit, check the ending: {fields}.

confirm.title: Replace the English text?
confirm.body: The English box already has text. The translation from Romanian replaces it; nothing is saved until you press Save.

allTitle.one: {count} English box already has text. Replace it?
allTitle.few: {count} English boxes already have text. Replace them?
allTitle.other: {count} English boxes already have text. Replace them?

confirm.allBody: Already written: {fields}. «Replace everything» translates them again from Romanian; «Only the empty ones», when it shows, leaves them untouched and fills the rest. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
confirm.bigBody: The English boxes are filled with the translation, with the same layout. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
confirm.budget: About {count} characters of today's budget will be sent.
confirm.budgetEmpty: The empty ones alone: about {count} characters.

refusal.forbidden: Your role cannot use automatic translation.
refusal.notConfigured: Automatic translation is not set up on this server (the DeepL key is missing).
refusal.invalid: This box cannot be translated automatically.
refusal.nothing: The Romanian box is empty: there is nothing to translate.
refusal.nothingAll: Nothing to translate: write the Romanian texts first.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many translations in the last hour. Try again in a few minutes.
refusal.budget: This translation needs more than is left of today's budget (characters left: {remaining}). Translate fewer boxes at once or come back tomorrow; an Administrator can raise it under Settings → Costs.
refusal.quota: DeepL has no characters left on this key: the credit is spent. Translation comes back when an Administrator sets a new credit or key (Tasks → Club).
refusal.refused: DeepL refused the key. An Administrator needs to check DEEPL_API_KEY (Tasks).
refusal.unavailable: DeepL did not answer. Try again in a minute.
refusal.failed: The translation did not start. Check the connection and try again.
refusal.credit: This translation asks for more than is left of the DeepL credit (characters left: {remaining}). Translate fewer boxes at once; an Administrator sees the credit under Settings → Costs.

BotCheck.interactive: Tick the box above: that is how we know you are not a robot.
BotCheck.expired: The check expired — it is being redone. If it is not, press “Retry the check”.
BotCheck.timeout: The box waited too long and was drawn again — tick it once more.
BotCheck.error: The anti-bot check did not work; it is retrying by itself. You can press “Retry the check”.
BotCheck.unsupported: Your browser cannot run the anti-bot check. We could not check automatically; we send it anyway, and the club confirms.
BotCheck.blocked: The anti-bot check did not load — a network or a browser extension may be blocking it. We could not check automatically; we send it anyway, and the club confirms. You can also press “Retry the check”.
BotCheck.slow: The check is taking longer than usual. Press “Retry the check” — or send the form: it goes without the check in a few seconds.
BotCheck.failed: We could not check automatically; we send it anyway, and the club confirms. You can also press “Retry the check”.

plain.unsupported: Your browser cannot run the anti-bot check. You can send anyway.
plain.blocked: The anti-bot check did not load — a network or a browser extension may be blocking it. You can send anyway, or press “Retry the check”.
plain.slow: The check is taking longer than usual. Press “Retry the check” — or send anyway.
plain.failed: The check failed; you can send anyway. You can also press “Retry the check”.
